source: PlayerAttackEvent
zh: 玩家攻击事件

source: A `PlayerAttackEvent` bukkit event is called every time a player deals damage to another entity. The event contains all the info about the player attacking, the damage being dealt and the attack target.
zh: 每当玩家对另一个实体造成伤害时，就会调用`PlayerAttackEvent`bukkit 事件。该事件包含有关玩家攻击、造成的伤害和攻击目标的所有信息。

source: `AttackMetadata` contains:
zh: `AttackMetadata`包含：

source: the player attacking
zh: 玩家攻击

source: the entity being attacked
zh: 被攻击的实体

source: a cached map of the player statistics which was generated when the player cast the skill/attack
zh: 当玩家施放技能/攻击时生成的玩家属性的缓存地图

zh: DamageMetadata 的一个实例

source: increase any damage due to a specific type by X%

source: add extra elemental/typed damage packets

source: A damage metadata is composed of a set of damage packets. A damage packet is one double indicating the amount of damage dealt as well as a set of damage types. This packet method lets MythicLib distinguish damage sources and only apply modifiers to some of them.

source: Using damage packets, you can have your skill deal like 10 weapon-physical damage + 15 skill-magical damage, under one DamageMetadata. And if the player happens to have a stat like +50% Skill Damage, this stat will only apply to the packets which have at least SKILL as damage type! This allows for insane on-hit extra RPG styled damage calculations. Example use:
zh: 使用伤害数据包，你可以在一个 DamageMetadata 下让你的技能造成类似于10weapon-physical伤害 +15skill-magical伤害的伤害。如果玩家恰好有属性类似 +50%技能损坏，则此属性将仅适用于至少有技能作为损坏类型的数据包！这允许疯狂的on-hit额外的RPG风格的伤害计算。使用示例：

source: Using DamageManager
zh: 使用伤害管理器

source: It's the class MythicLib uses to centralize all the player attacks from MMOItems and MMOCore. The following code snippet can be used to force a player to deal damage to a certain entity. You first have to specify the damage you want to deal, as well as the damage types. Then cache the player's statistics before defining the AttackMetadata and registering it using MythicLib's damage manager.

source: Compatibility with other plugins which have a damage system
zh: 与其他具有损坏系统的插件的兼容性

source: Take any other plugin which implements magic skills like Fabled or Heroes. MMOCore needs a way to detect when a player damages an entity using a skill, so that it can apply the `Skill Damage` stat for instance. It's what the `DamageManager` class is all about: monitoring all damage dealt by players.
zh: 采用任何其他实现魔法技能的插件，例如Fabled或Heroes。MMOCore需要一种方法来检测玩家何时使用技能损坏实体，以便它可以应用`Skill Damage`属性等。这就是`DamageManager`类的全部内容：监视玩家造成的所有伤害。

source: Other plugins which have a damage system need to register their damage info in MythicLib whenever an entity is damaged by a player, so that MythicLib knows that some custom damage is being applied. If MythicLib detects player damage but cannot find the source plugin, it is considered a melee weapon attack.
zh: 每当实体被玩家损坏时，其他具有损坏系统的插件都需要在MythicLib中注册其损坏信息，以便MythicLib知道正在应用一些自定义损坏。如果MythicLib检测到玩家损坏但找不到源插件，则视为近战武器攻击。

source: Damage Mitigation
zh: 伤害减免

source: Whenever a mitigation type is triggered by a player, an instance of `DamageMitigationEvent` is called. You can retrieve the mitigation type using `event#getType()`. This event is cancelable.
zh: 每当玩家触发缓解类型时，就会调用`DamageMitigationEvent`的实例。你可以使用`event#getType()`检索缓解类型。此活动可以取消。

source: On-Hit Effects
zh: On-Hit效果器

source: Whenever an on-hit effect is triggered, an instance of `OnHitEffectEvent` is called. You can retrieve the on-hit effect using `event#getEffect()`. This event is cancelable.
zh: 每当触发on-hit效果时，就会调用`OnHitEffectEvent`的实例。你可以使用`event#getEffect()`检索on-hit效果。此活动可以取消。

source: Damage Indicators
zh: 伤害显示

source: Stat Instances
zh: 属性实例

source: Just like Spigot's attribute instances, stat instances feature a map that **stores stat modifiers**. There are two different types of stat modifiers:
zh: 就像Spigot的属性实例一样，属性实例具有一个 **存储属性修正器** 的映射。属性修正器有两种不同类型：

source: fixed stat modifiers, which add a fixed/flat amount (+10 Atk Damage)
zh: 修复了属性修正器，增加了固定/固定金额（+10Atk Damage）

source: % stat modifiers, which multiply the total stat value by a certain constant (+10% Atk Damage)
zh: % stat modifiers, which multiply the total stat value by a certain constant (+10%攻击力伤害)

source: The advantage of using attributes is that any plugin can add its own attributes, and MythicLib can easily gather all of them and calculate the total stat value based on these attributes. For instance, MMOCore uses attributes to handle experience party buffs:
zh: 使用属性的优点是任何插件都可以添加自己的属性，MythicLib可以轻松收集所有属性并根据这些属性计算属性总值。例如，MMOCore使用属性来处理体验队伍增益：

source: Notice how any plugin can access all the modifiers created by all the plugins. That means you must make sure your plugin only manipulates the attributes you create which can be done by choosing a very specific **modifier key** like "mmocorePartyBuff" or "mmoitemsItemSetBonus".
zh: 请注意任何插件如何访问所有插件创建的所有修饰符。这意味着你必须确保你的插件仅操作你创建的属性，这可以通过选择非常具体的**修饰键**（如“mmocorePartyBuff”或“mmoitemsItemSetBonus”）来完成。

source: The first parameter is the UUID. When not provided, a random UUID gets assigned to your new modifier. Every modifier is identified by a UUID. The second parameter, the **modifier key** can also be used to quickly identify the plugin which registered the modifier, but it's **NOT UNIQUE!!** The plugin key should be your plugin name, to make sure that there are no collisions with other systems or plugins. source: The **equipment slot** was implemented to keep track of where that modifier is coming from. It's mostly used by MMOItems and MMOInventory to apply the right stats from an item depending on where it's equipped in the player inventory.
zh: **设备槽**的实现是为了跟踪该修改器的来源。它主要由MMOItems和MMOInventory使用，根据玩家物品栏中配备的位置，从物品应用正确的属性。

source: The **modifier source** was implemented to differentiate stat modifiers given by melee and ranged weapons. This is also used by MI and MMOInventory to fix similar issues.
zh: **修改器源**的实现是为了区分近战和远程武器给出的属性修正器。 MI 和MMOInventory也使用此方法来解决类似问题。

zh: 计算玩家属性

source: The following code snippet shows how to calculate the total value of a stat.

source: Stat values depend on the player's action hand. Most of the time, they are interacting with their main hand (right hand), but sometimes they might be using their off hand (left hand) like when shooting a bow or throwing a snowball. In that case, MythicLib must ignore some stat modifiers depending on which hand is being used.
zh: 属性值取决于玩家的动作手。大多数时候，他们使用主手（右手）进行交互，但有时他们可能会使用副手（左手），例如射弓或扔雪球时。在这种情况下，MythicLib必须忽略一些属性修正器，具体取决于正在使用哪只手。

source: By default, MythicLib assumes the action hand is the right hand. If you need to compute a stat value with the left hand as action hand, you can use the following method:

source: MythicLib does fancy calculation to determine which modifiers to ignore, and which to keep, based on the equipment slot and modifier sources of the registered stat modifiers. All of this is already taken care of internally, so you don't have to worry about it!
zh: MythicLib根据注册的属性修正器的设备槽和修改器源进行奇特的计算，以确定忽略哪些修改器以及保留哪些修改器。所有这些都已经在内部处理好，所以你不必担心！

source: *Total* vs *Final* Stat Value
zh: *总计* 与 *最终*属性值

source: Vanilla attribute-based stats like Attack Damage, Max Health, Movement Speed are a little harder to deal with. This is because, as they are handled by Minecraft itself, MythicLib has no guarantee that it is the only plugin modifying these stats. Other plugins may also add their own attribute modifiers, and Minecraft itself applies some default modifiers depending on the player's equipment.
zh: 原版attribute-based属性像攻击伤害、最大生命值，移动速度有点难对付。这是因为，由于它们是由Minecraft本身处理的，因此MythicLib不能保证它是修改这些属性的唯一插件。其他插件也可能会添加自己的属性修饰符，而Minecraft本身会根据玩家的装备应用一些默认修饰符。

source: For this reason, the *final* stat value refers to **the value that Minecraft would return**, that is, taking into account all attribute modifiers from all plugins and Minecraft itself. The *total* stat value refers to the value that MythicLib computes, taking into account only the stat modifiers registered through MythicLib's API.
zh: 因此，*最终*属性值指的是 **Minecraft将返回的值**，即考虑到所有插件和Minecraft本身的所有属性修饰符。 *总*属性值是指MythicLib计算的值，仅考虑通过MythicLib的API注册的属性修正器。

source: For example, if a player with 20 base Max Health is wearing a +10 Max Health armor (MythicLib API), and another plugin adds +5 Max Health through its own Minecraft attribute modifier, then the total Max Health would be 30, while the final Max Health would be 35.
zh: 例如，如果带有20底座最大生命值的玩家佩戴 +10最大生命值护甲(MythicLibAPI)，而另一个插件添加 +5最大生命值通过其自身的Minecraft属性修饰符，那么总的最大生命值将是30，而最终的最大生命值将是35。

source: > For non-vanilla stats like *Critical Strike Chance* or *Skill Damage*, the total and final stat values are always the same, as these stats are not handled by Minecraft itself.
zh: > 对于non-vanilla属性，例如 *暴击几率* 或 *技能Damage*，属性的总值和最终值始终相同，因为这些属性不由Minecraft本身处理。

source: 🪲 Frequent Issues
zh: 🪲 常见问题

source: Use this list of common issues with MythicLib/MMOItems/MMOCore to self-diagnose your issue whenever you feel like something isn't right.
zh: 每当你觉得有问题时，请使用MythicLib/MMOItems/MMOCore到self-diagnose的常见问题列表。

source: Sometimes support over the Discord server is pretty slow given the amount of tickets and staff availability. Before reporting a bug using a Discord ticket, please make sure your issue is not one of the following. If you can fix it yourself using the following instructions, you will both gain time (that you'd have lost waiting for an answer) and make staff gain time so that they can work on fixing more complex bugs.
zh: 有时，考虑到票证数量和工作人员的可用性，Discord服务器的支持速度相当慢。在使用Discord票证报告错误之前，请确保你的问题不是以下问题之一。如果你可以按照以下说明自行修复问题，那么你既可以赢得时间（你在等待答案时会浪费时间），也可以让员工获得时间来修复更复杂的错误。

source: Issues specific to one of the MMO plugins are marked with brackets, like `Cannot cast abilities (MMOItems)`.
zh: 特定于 MMO 插件之一的问题用括号标记，例如`Cannot cast abilities (MMOItems)`。

source: Always check your full server logs for plugin error logs because more than half the issues come with logs associated with them. Frequent issues that spawn with error logs are presented in the following list.
zh: 请务必检查完整服务器日志中的插件错误日志，因为超过一半的问题都与它们相关的日志有关。下面的列表列出了错误日志中出现的常见问题。

source: Keep MythicLib up-to-date
zh: 保留MythicLibup-to-date

source: Keep in mind MythicLib is necessary to run MMOItems/MMOCore and that it is a plugin too. An MMOItems might be caused by an anterior MythicLib startup issue. Always make sure it's not a bug with MythicLib first.
zh: 请记住，MythicLib是运行MMOItems/MMOCore所必需的，而且它也是一个插件。MMOItems可能是由前面的MythicLib启动问题引起的。首先始终确保这不是MythicLib的错误。

source: Outdated Plugins
zh: 过时的插件

source: Error logs indicating a `NoClassDefFoundError` or `NoSuchMethodError` indicate that a plugin cannot find a class or method it was compiled with.
zh: 指示`NoClassDefFoundError`或`NoSuchMethodError`的错误日志表明插件找不到职业或其编译方法。

source: 90% of the time, these errors are due to an outdated version of one of the MMO plugins or MythicLib. Download the latest releases/dev builds of all MMO plugins and try again.
zh: 90%当时，这些错误是由于 MMO 插件之一或MythicLib的过时版本造成的。下载所有 MMO 插件的最新版本/开发版本，然后重试。

source: Sometimes, these errors are due to a compatibility issue with external plugins, for instance if an external developer has changed something in their plugin API.
zh: 有时，这些错误是由于外部插件的兼容性问题造成的，例如，如果外部开发人员更改了其插件API中的某些内容。

source: Plugin loading order issue
zh: 插件加载顺序问题

source: Severe plugin compatibility issues can happen when the MMO plugins don't load in a specific predefined order on server startup. It does sometimes happen with circular dependencies (A -> B -> C -> A), forcing Bukkit or Spigot to ignore soft dependencies. **The most common issue is MythicMobs loading after all of the MMO plugins, which shouldn't happen. The required load order is the following:**
zh: 当 MMO 插件在服务器启动时未按特定的预定义顺序加载时，可能会出现严重的插件兼容性问题。有时确实会发生循环依赖关系（A -> B -> C -> A），迫使Bukkit或Spigot忽略软依赖关系。 **最常见的问题是MythicMobs在所有 MMO 插件之后加载，这是不应该发生的。所需的加载顺序如下：**

source: `MythicMobs > MythicLib > MMOCore > MMOItems > MMOInventory`
zh: `MythicMobs > MythicLib > MMOCore > MMOItems > MMOInventory`

source: Recent versions of MythicLib contain a script that checks for circular dependencies. If you are having loading order issues, check the startup logs of MythicLib as they will most likely indicate a message that looks like this:
zh: MythicLib的最新版本包含一个检查循环依赖关系的脚本。如果你遇到加载顺序问题，请检查MythicLib的启动日志，因为它们很可能会显示如下所示的消息：

source: If you get such a message, you can either uninstall one of the plugins in the loop to break it, or try and correct the load order manually using the following fix. You can also contact the developers of the plugins involved as it unfortunately is up to them to fix that dependency cycle.

source: `java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: cc/javajobs/factionsbridge/FactionsBridge`
zh: `java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: cc/javajobs/factionsbridge/FactionsBridge`

source: You most likely have a Factions plugin installed. You need to install [FactionsBridge](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/factionsbridge.89716/) which is a hard dependency when using any Factions plugin (it's like Vault but for factions). MythicLib has native support for most Factions plugins: you cannot deal skill damage to players within the same faction.
zh: 你很可能安装了 Factions 插件。你需要安装 [FactionsBridge](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/factionsbridge.89716/)，这是使用任何 Factions 插件时的硬依赖项（它类似于Vault，但针对派系）。MythicLib对大多数派系插件具有原生支持：你无法对同一派系内的玩家造成技能伤害。

source: Mana from AureliumSkills not working on items (MMOItems)

source: Sometimes AureliumSkills integration will fail with MMOItems. You can diagnose this issue by using `/mi debug info` which will display most fields (level and mana) to 0 even though AureliumSkills action bar says otherwise.
zh: 有时 AureliumSkills 集成会因MMOItems失败。你可以使用`/mi debug info`来诊断此问题，它将向0显示大多数字段（等级和魔力），即使 AureliumSkills 动作栏另有说明。

source: This sometimes happens when reloading the server, in which case a simple relog will fix the issue on the player side. Just make sure you fully restart the server instead of using `/reload`, which often ends up messing stuff up with plugins.
zh: 重新加载服务器时有时会发生这种情况，在这种情况下，简单的重新登录即可解决玩家端的问题。只需确保完全重新启动服务器而不是使用`/reload`，这通常会导致插件弄乱。

source: Updating your server from 1.20.4 to 1.20.5+

Minecraft 1.20.5 changes how NBT tags are stored within items. While vanilla Minecraft makes sure to convert items placed inside of player and chest inventories, items stored in non-vanilla/external databases (MMOProfiles, MMOInventory...) are not automatically converted.
zh: Minecraft1.20.5更改NBT标签在物品中的存储方式。虽然原版Minecraft确保转换放置在玩家和胸部物品栏内部的物品，但存储在non-vanilla/外部数据库（MMOProfiles、MMOInventory...）中的物品不会自动转换转换。

source: If you are updating your server from <1.20.4 to any version above, you have to convert your items stored in your MMOProfiles/MMOInventory databases to a format that does not depend on server version, upgrade your server, and convert the items back. Fortunately, MMOLib has a tool to have this done automatically. This tool comprises one command and requires NBTAPI to be installed.
zh: 如果你要将服务器从 <1.20.4更新到以上任何版本，则必须将MMOProfiles/MMOInventory数据库中存储的物品转换为不依赖于服务器版本的格式，升级服务器，然后将物品转换回来。幸运的是，MMOLib 有一个工具可以自动完成此操作。该工具包含一个命令，并且需要安装 NBTAPI。

source: Download [NBTAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/nbt-api.7939/) from here and install it on your server.
zh: 从这里下载 [NBTAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/nbt-api.7939/)并将其安装在你的服务器上。

source: Close your server and **backup your MMOProfiles/MMOInventory user data**.
zh: 关闭你的服务器并**备份你的MMOProfiles/MMOInventory用户数据**。

source: Start your server in **1.20.4 or lower** and **make sure no players log in** while performing the following steps.
zh: 在执行以下步骤时，以 **1.20.4或更低版本**启动服务器，并**确保没有玩家登录**。

source: Run the commands `mmoprofiles convert-item-nbts` and `mmoinventory convert-item-nbts` from the server console and wait for completion. Your items are now in a version-safe data format.
zh: 从服务器控制台运行命令`mmoprofiles convert-item-nbts`和`mmoinventory convert-item-nbts`并等待完成。你的物品现在采用version-safe数据格式。

source: Close your server. You can now safely upgrade to 1.20.5+
zh: 关闭你的服务器。你现在可以安全升级到1.20.5+

source: Start your updated server, run the following commands from the server console: `mmoprofiles convert-item-nbts from` and `mmoinventory convert-item-nbts from` (notice the second "from" parameter) and wait for completion.
zh: 启动更新的服务器，从服务器控制台运行以下命令：`mmoprofiles convert-item-nbts from`和`mmoinventory convert-item-nbts from`（注意第二个“from”参数）并等待完成。

source: You can now uninstall NBTAPI from your server. Players can now safely log in again.
zh: 你现在可以从服务器卸载 NBTAPI。玩家现在可以再次安全登录。

source: You can take your time after running the first command batch, just make sure no player logs in after using the commands and before you upgrade your server version. Otherwise, the player who logged in in the meantime will suffer from item NBT corruption.
zh: 你可以在运行第一个命令批处理后慢慢来，只需确保在使用命令后和升级服务器版本之前没有玩家登录即可。否则，同时登录的玩家将遭受物品NBT损坏。

source: Notes
zh: 注释

source: MythicLib has a built-in module for mana and stamina. When running the MMO plugin suite, Mana is usually provided by MMOCore. For users who would like to use MMOItems without MMOCore, we provide this barebones Mana/Stamina solution. This built-in module replaces the old [Mana & Stamina Addon](https://github.com/mmopluginteam/mmoitems-mana) (no longer maintained).
zh: MythicLib有一个用于魔力和耐力的built-in模块。运行 MMO 插件套件时，魔力通常由MMOCore提供。对于想要在没有MMOCore的情况下使用MMOItems的用户，我们提供了这个准系统魔力/耐力解决方案。该built-in模块取代了旧的 [魔力和耐力插件](https://github.com/mmopluginteam/mmoitems-mana)（不再维护）。

source: Some plugins like [mcMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/official-mcmmo.64348/) or [McRPG](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mcrpg.63020/) have a *power level*, which is usually the sum of the individual player's skill levels. MythicLib interprets this power level as the player's level.
zh: 一些插件，如 [mcMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/official-mcmmo.64348/)或 [McRPG](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mcrpg.63020/)] 具有*功率等级*，通常是各个玩家的技能等级的总和。MythicLib将此功率等级解释为玩家的等级。

source: Several plugins only have one type of player resource, which is usually Mana. In that case, Stamina is replaced by food level. The second player resource is almost always Stamina.
zh: 一些插件只有一种类型的玩家资源，通常是魔力。在这种情况下，耐力将替换为食品等级。第二个玩家资源几乎总是耐力。

source: Using Placeholders
zh: 使用占位符

source: You can also provide player classes and levels to MMO plugins using PlaceholderAPI placeholders. MythicLib will parse the placeholders using PlaceholderAPI and forward the results to the MMO plugins.
zh: 你还可以使用PlaceholderAPI占位符向 MMO 插件提供玩家职业和等级。MythicLib将使用PlaceholderAPI解析占位符并将结果转发给MMO插件。

source: For example, if your RPG plugin `SomeRpgCore` is not natively supported by MMOCore but provides a `%somerpgcore_class%` placeholder for the class name, set `class-plugin` to `%somerpgcore_class%`. MythicLib will then use the placeholder output as the player's current class name. Similarly, if your RPG plugin provides a `%somerpgcore_level%` placeholder, you can use it for `level-plugin`.
zh: 例如，如果你的RPG插件`SomeRpgCore`本身不受MMOCore支持，但为职业名称提供了`%somerpgcore_class%`占位符，请将`class-plugin`设置为`%somerpgcore_class%`。  然后，MythicLib将使用占位符输出作为玩家的当前职业名称。同样，如果你的RPG插件提供了`%somerpgcore_level%`占位符，你可以将其用于`level-plugin`。

source: > Note that the placeholder used to provide the player's level must return a properly formatted integer, as MythicLib will parse it as an integer.
zh: > 请注意，用于提供玩家等级的占位符必须返回格式正确的整数，因为MythicLib会将其解析为整数。

source: MythicLib allows to separately choose the class, level, and mana plugins. For instance, you can simultaneously use classes from MMOCore, levels from mcMMO and mana/stamina from Fabled. You can use the same plugin for levels, classes and/or mana/stamina.
zh: MythicLib允许单独选择职业、等级和魔力插件。例如，你可以同时使用MMOCore中的职业、mcMMO 中的等级和Fabled中的魔力/耐力。你可以对等级、职业和/或魔力/耐力使用相同的插件。

source: In order to choose your class plugin, go to your MythicLib `config.yml` and set the `class-plugin` option.
zh: 要选择职业插件，请转到MythicLib`config.yml`并设置`class-plugin`选项。

source: In order to choose your level plugin, go to your MythicLib `config.yml` and set the `level-plugin` option.
zh: 要选择关卡插件，请转到MythicLib`config.yml`并设置`level-plugin`选项。

source: ‼️ Damage Indicators
zh: ‼️伤害显示

source: You can edit damage and regen indicators in the config file `indicators.yml`. MythicLib can use a wide range of popular holograms plugins to display regen/attack indicators around the target entity.
zh: 你可以在配置文件`indicators.yml`中编辑损坏和再生指示器。MythicLib可以使用各种流行的全息图插件来显示目标实体周围的再生/攻击指示器。

source: MythicLib can use a wide range of hologram plugins to display these indicators. Please see [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#hologram-plugins) for the list of hologram plugins supported by MythicLib.
zh: MythicLib可以使用各种全息图插件来显示这些指标。请参阅[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#hologram-plugins)以获取MythicLib支持的全息图插件列表。

source: You can edit the indicator formats using the `format` option. The `icon` section lets you configure the icons that correspond to every damage type.
zh: 你可以使用`format`选项编辑指标格式。`icon`部分允许你配置与每种损坏类型相对应的图标。

source: Physics Options
zh: 物理选项

source: When increasing `radial_velocity` the holo will fly farther away (if the holo plugin you're using supports moving holograms - some just don't -). Increasing the `gravity` option will make your holo fly faster to the ground. Conversely increasing `initial_upward_velocity` will make your holo fly higher. `y_offset` can be used if you want to apply a flat Y offset to the location where you're displaying the damage indicators. Last but not least, setting `entity_height_percent` to `.75` - for instance - will have the holo display at 75% of the target entity's height (this then stacks up with the flat Y coordinate offset), and setting it to 100% will have it display at the top of the entity's bounding box.
zh: 当增加`radial_velocity`时，全息图会飞得更远（如果你使用的全息图插件支持移动全息图 - 有些不支持 -）。增加`gravity`选项将使你的全息飞得更快到地面。反之，增加`initial_upward_velocity`会让你的全息飞得更高。  如果你想将平面 Y 偏移应用到显示伤害显示的位置，则可以使用`y_offset`。最后但并非最不重要的一点是，例如，将`entity_height_percent`设置为`.75`将使全息显示在目标实体高度的75%处（然后与平面 Y 坐标偏移叠加），并将其设置为100%将使其显示在实体边界框的顶部。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/damage_indicators.CqYqRaSc.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/damage_indicators.CqYqRaSc.png)

source: When toggling off `move`, holograms will be static and won't move from their initial position.
zh: 当关闭`move`时，全息图将是静态的，不会从其初始位置移动。

source: Holograms
zh: 全息图

source: When toggling on `split_holograms`, each icon will be displayed in its own hologram rather than all icons being displayed in the same hologram. When set to `false`, you can configure how the icons are joined together using the `holograms_join` config option. For instance, if you set it to a comma followed by a space `" "`, an indicator displaying both weapon and skill damage will show the weapon icon, then a comma and a space, then the skill icon. This would look like this: `🗡, ☄` (followed by the indicator damage value).
zh: 当切换`split_holograms`时，每个图标将显示在自己的全息图中，而不是所有图标都显示在同一个全息图中。当设置为`false`时，你可以使用`holograms_join`配置选项配置图标的连接方式。例如，如果将其设置为逗号后跟空格`" "`，则显示武器和技能伤害的指示器将显示武器图标，然后是逗号和空格，然后是技能图标。看起来像这样：`🗡, ☄`（后面是指示器损坏值）。

source: Using a custom font
zh: 使用自定义字体

source: Enable custom fonts by toggling on the `custom_fonts.enabled` config option. MythicLib will then replace any numeric character (0-9) with the character you specified in the config. You can also configure the character that ML is going to use for the decimal separator (`dot`) as well as a character that will be placed in between all the other characters.
zh: 通过切换`custom_fonts.enabled`配置选项来启用自定义字体。  然后，MythicLib将用你在配置中指定的字符替换任何数字字符（0-9）。你还可以配置 ML 将用作小数点分隔符 (`dot`) 的字符以及将放置在所有其他字符之间的字符。

source: Using custom textures you can then use a resource pack to have damage indicators with fully custom characters. Here is a [resource pack](https://www.dropbox.com/s/yih3hsdq6o6eak0/Font.zip?dl=1) that works with the default MythicLib config that you can check to understand how to use custom fonts within ML indicators.
zh: 使用自定义纹理，你可以使用资源包让伤害显示具有完全自定义的角色。这是一个[资源包](https://www.dropbox.com/s/yih3hsdq6o6eak0/Font.zip?dl=1)，可与默认的MythicLib配置配合使用，你可以检查该资源包以了解如何在 ML 指标中使用自定义字体。

source: `groupby`
zh: `groupby`

source: The parameter `group_by` lets you choose how damage packets are grouped together to form indicators. There are three available options:
zh: 参数`group_by`允许你选择如何将损坏数据包分组在一起以形成指示器。有以下三个可用选项：

source: `single`: groups all damage packets to the entity in one single indicator
zh: `single`：将实体的所有损坏数据包分组到一个指示器中

source: `packet`: creates one indicator per damage packet, where each indicator displays the total damage of the packet and its list of damage types (one icon per damage type). **This is the option most people would expect by default.**
zh: `packet`：为每个损坏数据包创建一个指示器，其中每个指示器显示数据包的总损坏及其损坏类型列表（每种损坏类型一个图标）。 **这是大多数人默认期望的选项。**

source: `type`: you choose what damage types are displayed. With this option, you need to specify the damage types to split by in the `damage_type_splits` config option. For each damage type specified, one indicator will be created displaying the total damage of that type. If a damage type is not present in the damage packet, no indicator will be created for it.
zh: `type`：你选择显示的伤害类型。使用此选项，你需要在`damage_type_splits`配置选项中指定要分割的损坏类型。对于指定的每种损坏类型，将创建一个指示器，显示该类型的总损坏。如果损坏包中不存在损坏类型，则不会为其创建任何指示符。

source: In case a single hologram contains multiple damage type icons, you can configure how the icons are joined together using the `damage_type_icon_join` config option. For instance, if you set it to a comma followed by a space `" "`, an indicator displaying both weapon and skill damage will show the weapon icon, then a space, then the skill icon. This would look like this: `🗡 ☄` (followed by the indicator damage value).
zh: 如果单个全息图包含多个损坏类型图标，你可以使用`damage_type_icon_join`配置选项配置图标的连接方式。例如，如果将其设置为逗号后跟空格`" "`，则显示武器和技能伤害的指示器将显示武器图标，然后是空格，然后是技能图标。看起来像这样：`🗡 ☄`（后面是指示器损坏值）。

source: Let's say that a player just hit a mob with a 100 Atk Damage weapon (*Physical, Weapon* damage). An on-hit skill triggers, dealing 30 *Skill, Magic* damage. Finally, elemental stats present on the item deal an additional 20 *Fire-Weapon* damage.
zh: 假设玩家刚刚击中了一个具有100攻击力伤害武器（*物理，武器*伤害）的生物。on-hit技能触发，造成30*技能，魔法*伤害。最后，物品上存在的元素属性会造成额外的20*Fire-Weapon* 伤害。

source: | Mode | Resulting Indicators | Comment |
zh: |模式|结果指标|评论 |

source: | `single` | `🗡☄✘ 150` | One single indicator |
zh: |`single`|`🗡☄✘ 150`|单一指标|

source: | `packet` | `🗡✘ 100`, `☄✩ 30`, `🔥🗡 20` | One per packet |
| `type` | `🗡 120`, `☄ 30` | One per damage type specified |
zh: |`type`|`🗡 120`、`☄ 30`|每个指定的损坏类型一个 |

source: Regen/Heal Indicators
zh: 再生/治疗指示器

source: They share most of their options with damage indicators. These appear when regenerating health through potions, natural regeneration, skills... You can also apply custom fonts to regen indicators following the same syntax as with damage indicators.
zh: 他们与伤害显示共享大部分选项。当通过药水、自然再生、技能恢复生命值时会出现这些。你还可以按照与伤害显示相同的语法将自定义字体应用于再生指示器。

source: ![regen_indic](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/regen_indicator.CagtvlJ1.png)
zh: ![regen_indic](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/regen_indicator.CagtvlJ1.png)

source: 💔 Damage
zh: 💔 伤害

source: MMOItems and MMOCore share the same damage system. Any attack, from melee sword hits to MMOCore abilities, has a specific set of damage types which can be any of the following:
zh: MMOItems和MMOCore具有相同的伤害系统。任何攻击，从近战剑击到MMOCore能力，都有一组特定的伤害类型，可以是以下任何一种：

source: **physical**, **magic** or **unarmed** damage
zh: **物理**、**魔法**或**徒手**伤害

source: **projectile** damage
zh: **射弹**伤害

source: **weapon** or **skill** damage
zh: **武器** 或 **技能** 损坏

source: **on-hit** damage (on-hit damage doesn't trigger on-hit effects)
zh: **on-hit** 伤害（on-hit伤害不会触发on-hit效果）

source: **dot** or damage over time
zh: **点**或随着时间的推移而损坏

source: **minion** damage
zh: **小兵**伤害

source: **e.g:** a bow deals weapon-physical-projectile damage. An ice crystal spell deals projectile-magic-skill damage.
zh: **e.g：** 弓造成weapon-physical-projectile伤害。冰晶法术造成projectile-magic-skill伤害。

source: Stats increasing damage dealt
zh: 属性造成的伤害增加

source: Attack damage can be increased by several stats including Physical/Magical/Projectile/Weapon/Skill damage, but also other damage stats including **PvE/PvP/Undead Damage** which rather depend on the entity you are attacking.
zh: 攻击伤害可以增加几个属性，包括物理/魔法/射弹/武器/技能伤害，但也可以增加其他伤害属性，包括**PvE/PvP/不死伤害**，这取决于你正在攻击的实体。

source: Since MythicLib 1.3 these stats all add up "linearly" and don't stack up geometrically. For instance, +50% skill damage and +50% magical damage will increase magical-skill damage by `50% + 50% = 100%` rather than `150% * 150% - 100% = 125%`. This 25% difference gets super huge when multiple stats are taken into account at the same time, like when adding PvE damage or Undead damage on top of it.
zh: 从 MythicLib 1.3 开始，这些增伤属性采用线性相加，不再逐项相乘。例如，+50% 技能伤害和 +50% 魔法伤害，对魔法技能的总增伤为 `50% + 50% = 100%`，而不是 `150% * 150% - 100% = 125%`。如果再叠加 PvE 伤害或亡灵伤害等多项属性，这 25% 的差距还会进一步放大。

source: Stats reducing incoming damage
zh: 属性减少传入伤害

source: These are stats like `Magic Damage Reduction` or `Damage Reduction`. Unlike damage-increasing stats, these stats do stack up geometrically. Combining *10% Dmg Red* and *10% Fall Dmg Red* will **NOT** result in `10% + 10% = 20%` damage reduction for fall damage, but rather `100% - 90% * 90% = 19%`. This 1% difference gets bigger the higher the player stats are.
zh: 这类属性包括 `Magic Damage Reduction` 和 `Damage Reduction`。与增伤属性不同，减伤属性采用乘法叠加。将 *10% Dmg Red* 和 *10% Fall Dmg Red* 组合时，摔落减伤**不是** `10% + 10% = 20%`，而是 `100% - 90% * 90% = 19%`。玩家属性越高，这 1% 的差距越明显。

source: This calculation makes these statistics less op when they get bigger, and also make sure the damage never reaches 0 and always stays positive. In a nutshell, when considering damage-increasing stats or damage reduction stats, MythicLib always considers what's worse for the attacker.
zh: 这种计算使得这些属性在变大时减少操作，并确保伤害永远不会达到0并始终保持正值。简而言之，当考虑damage-increasing属性或伤害减少属性时，MythicLib总是考虑对攻击者来说最糟糕的情况。

source: Defense is a player stat which you can use in both MMOItems and MMOCore. It was introduced to bypass the 30 armor points vanilla limit which prevents users from having high armor values. The defense formula can be edited in the main MythicLib plugin config.
zh: 防御是玩家属性，你可以在MMOItems和MMOCore中使用。引入它是为了绕过30护甲点原版限制，该限制可防止用户拥有较高的护甲值。防御公式可以在主MythicLib插件配置中编辑。

source: Here's a table indicating how much damage is dealt given an amount of elemental defense and initial attack points, using the default elemental defense formula which is the one used in Path of Exile. ![poe_armor](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/poe_armor.C-2kRLIh.png)
zh: 下面的表格显示了在给定元素防御量和初始攻击点的情况下，使用流放之路中使用的默认元素防御公式所造成的伤害。 ![poe_armor](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/poe_armor.C-2kRLIh.png)

source: This formula was changed in MythicLib 1.4 if you'd like to use the previous one, here it is. It has the downside of not taking into account the incoming amount of damage, making adjusting this formula for both high and low levels harder.
zh: 此公式已在MythicLib1.4中更改，如果你想使用前一个公式，请在此处。它的缺点是不考虑传入的伤害量，使得调整高等级和低等级的公式变得更加困难。

source: The most important math functions are supported by the formula interpreter. For instance, you can use `sqrt(16)` (returns 4), `pow(2, 3)` will return 8, `atan2`, `min(10, 5)` will return 5, etc. If you're unsure what methods are supported, just give them a try.
zh: 公式解释器支持最重要的数学函数。例如，你可以使用`sqrt(16)`（返回4），`pow(2, 3)`将返回8，`atan2`，`min(10, 5)`将返回5等。如果你不确定支持哪些方法，请尝试一下。

source: Weapons and skills can deal critical strikes, increasing the damage dealt. Please refer to the [On-Hit Effects](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/on-hit-effects) page for more information about critical strikes.
zh: 武器和技能可以造成暴击，增加造成的伤害。有关暴击的更多信息，请参阅 [On-Hit效果](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/on-hit-effects)页面。

source: Please refer to the [Damage Mitigation](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/mitigation-types) page for more information about damage mitigation.
zh: 有关伤害减免的更多信息，请参阅[伤害减免](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/mitigation-types)页面。

source: Please refer to [this page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage-indicators) for more information about damage indicators.
zh: 关于伤害显示的更多信息请参考【本页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage-indicators)】。

source: MythicMobs Compatibility
zh: MythicMobs兼容性

source: You can have mobs and skills from MythicMobs deal damage marked with MythicLib damage types. This way, player stats like *Magic Damage Reduction* or *Fire Defense* will apply to the damage dealt by MythicMobs.
zh: 你可以让MythicMobs中的小怪和技能造成标有MythicLib伤害类型的伤害。这样，玩家属性（例如*魔法伤害减免*或*火焰防御*）将适用于MythicMobs造成的伤害。

source: To have a MythicMobs skill deal damage with MMO damage types, use the [mmodamage mechanic](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic.html#dealing-damage). This mechanics works whether the skill caster is a player or a mob.
zh: 要让MythicMobs技能处理 MMO 伤害类型的伤害，请使用 [mmodamage 机制](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic.html#dealing-damage)。无论技能施法者是玩家还是生物，该机制都有效。

source: To have MythicMobs deal MMO-typed damage with their melee attacks, use the `setmmodamagesplits` mechanic. The following mob deals 10 Magic-Projectile damage on each melee hit:
zh: 要让MythicMobs通过近战攻击造成MMO-typed伤害，请使用`setmmodamagesplits`机制。以下生物在每次近战攻击时造成10Magic-Projectile伤害：

source: > The mob above casts `setmmodamagesplits` when it spawns. However, you can use this mechanic at any time! You can replace a mob's damage splits mid-fight, during a specific skill, etc. For instance, you can have a boss deal Physical damage during its first phase, then switch to Magic damage during its second phase.
zh: > 上面的生物在生成时会施放`setmmodamagesplits`。但是，你可以随时使用此机制！你可以在特定的技能等期间替换生物的伤害分割mid-fight等。例如，你可以让 Boss 在第一阶段造成物理伤害，然后在第二阶段切换为魔法伤害。

source: In the following example, a third of the damage is dealt as Physical/Weapon, while the remaining two thirds are dealt as Skill-Magic damage.
zh: 在以下示例中，三分之一的伤害作为物理/武器造成，而其余三分之二作为Skill-Magic伤害造成。

source: The format for `splits` is `[TYPE1,TYPE2,...]:amount1,[TYPE3,TYPE4,...]:amount2` where each split is separated by a comma. The amount is optional and defaults to 1.
zh: `splits`的格式为`[TYPE1,TYPE2,...]:amount1,[TYPE3,TYPE4,...]:amount2`，其中每个分割以逗号分隔。金额是可选的，默认为1。

source: Change damage types of skills
zh: 更改技能的伤害类型

source: Skills that deal damage can have their damage types changed. For more information, please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin#edit-damage-types-of-built-in-skills).
zh: 技能造成伤害的伤害类型可以改变。欲了解更多信息，请参阅[此wiki页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin#edit-damage-types-of-built-in-skills)。

source: 🌱 Elements
zh: 🌱 元素

source: Elements are a big part of a RPG server. Using MythicLib custom elements, you can create elemental attacks with fully configurable attack effects. You can also setup elemental critical strikes which are attacks that have some chance of triggering when dealing elemental damage. Custom elements were introduced in MythicLib 1.3.4
zh: 元件是RPG服务器的重要组成部分。使用MythicLib自定义元素，你可以创建具有完全可配置攻击效果的元素攻击。你还可以设置元素暴击，这是在造成元素伤害时有一定几率触发的攻击。MythicLib1.3.4中引入了自定义元素

source: The config file you'll be editing is `/MythicLib/elements.yml`
zh: 你要编辑的配置文件是`/MythicLib/elements.yml`

source: Elemental attacks
zh: 元素攻击

source: Skills can be used to deal **elemental damage** using the following MythicMobs mechanic where you can replace `FIRE` with any element identifier.
zh: 技能可用于使用以下MythicMobs机制来处理**元素伤害**，你可以将`FIRE`替换为任何元素标识符。

source: Elemental attacks also trigger when performing weapon (melee or ranged) attacks.
zh: 执行武器（近战或远程）攻击时也会触发元素攻击。

source: Damage Calculation
zh: 伤害计算

source: Incoming Damage
zh: 即将到来的伤害

source: There are two different stats for increasing a player's elemental damage. You can either give a **flat amount** of elemental damage like this item. The following item deals an extra 10 damage on hit. The corresponding stat is `<ELEMENT_NAME>_DAMAGE`, for instance `FIRE_DAMAGE`.
zh: 有两种不同的属性用于增加玩家的元素伤害。你可以提供**固定数量**的元素伤害，例如物品。以下物品击中时会造成额外的10伤害。对应的属性为`<ELEMENT_NAME>_DAMAGE`，例如`FIRE_DAMAGE`。

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/fire_damage.ByW9dfuk.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/fire_damage.ByW9dfuk.png)

source: You can also use `<ELEMENT_NAME>_DAMAGE_PERCENT` which will increase your elemental damage by a certain coefficient. For instance, wearing the following item will increase your Fire Damage by 13%. Since it's a damage multiplier, you won't deal any fire damage if you have no item dealing base/flat damage.
zh: 你也可以使用`<ELEMENT_NAME>_DAMAGE_PERCENT`，这会增加你的元素伤害一定的系数。例如，佩戴以下物品将使你的火焰伤害增加13%。由于它是伤害倍增器，因此如果你没有物品造成基础/固定伤害，你将不会造成任何火焰伤害。

zh: 元素弱点会增加特定因素所受到的元素伤害。例如，10%火焰弱点将增加10%的火焰伤害。对应的玩家属性是`<ELEMENT_NAME>_WEAKNESS`。

source: Element Config Example

Once you're done editing you can use `/ml reload` which will reload the new config into MythicLib. Then hit `/mi reload` or `/mmocore reload` to have the changes propagate to MMOItems and MMOCore.

source: The `name`, `icon`, `lore-icon` and `color` options are all cosmetic. The most importants are `regular-attack` which is the skill that is cast by the attacker when performing an elemental attack, and `crit-strike` which is the skill cast when performing an elemental critical strike. By default, MythicLib uses custom scripts to handle these attack skills yet you can use other plugins like MythicMobs or Fabled.

source: 🛡️ Damage Mitigation
zh: 🛡️伤害减免

source: *Damage Mitigation* refers to the various ways a player can reduce or avoid incoming damage from attacks. While MythicLib provides several built-in mitigation types (*Block*, *Dodge*, and *Parry*), you can also create custom mitigation types to suit your server's needs.
zh: *伤害减免* 指的是玩家可以减少或避免攻击造成的伤害的各种方式。虽然MythicLib提供了多种built-in缓解类型（*Block*、*Dodge* 和 *Parry*），但你还可以创建自定义缓解类型以满足服务器的需求。

source: Built-in Mitigation Types
zh: Built-in缓解类型

source: Blocking
zh: 阻塞

source: When blocking a melee or projectile attack, a player reduces damage taken by a significant amount. Both the block chance and block power (percentage of damage you are blocking) can be increased by items. Blocking power has a default value and a cap, meaning that if a player has no item giving him extra block power, he will block at least 20% of the damage taken. Blocking power can't exceed 75%. The chance of blocking an attack is determined by the *Block Rating* stat.
zh: 当格挡近战或射弹攻击时，玩家会大幅减少受到的伤害。物品可以增加格挡几率和格挡威力（你格挡的伤害百分比）。格挡能力有默认值和上限，这意味着如果玩家没有物品给予他额外的格挡能力，他将至少格挡20%所受到的伤害。阻挡能力不能超过75%。阻止攻击的机会由 *阻止等级*属性决定。

source: Dodging
zh: 闪避

source: When dodging a melee or projectile attack, a player entirely **negates** damage taken and performs a quick dash backwards, allowing him to escape from the fight. The chance of dodging an attack is capped at 80%.
zh: 当躲避近战或射弹攻击时，玩家会完全**抵消**受到的伤害，并快速向后冲刺，让他逃离战斗。躲避攻击的几率上限为80%。

source: Parrying
zh: 招架

source: Just like dodging, parrying entirely negates attack damage and knocks the attacker back.
zh: 就像躲避一样，格挡会完全否定攻击伤害并将攻击者击退。

source: The knockback force can be edited in the main MythicLib config file.
zh: 可以在主MythicLib配置文件中编辑击退强制。

source: Mitigation Cooldown Reduction
zh: 缓解措施冷却时间减少

source: Every mitigation stat also features a cooldown reduction stat. By default, a player cannot dodge, parry or block more than one attack every few seconds. These cooldown stats lower that delay, which can be really useful if the player is running low on health.
zh: 每个缓解属性还具有冷却时间缓解属性。默认情况下，玩家每隔几秒无法闪避、招架或格挡一次以上攻击。这些冷却时间属性降低了延迟，如果玩家运行状况不佳，这可能非常有用。

source: Custom Mitigation Types
zh: 自定义缓解类型

source: You can create your own custom mitigation types by adding new sections to the `MythicLib/mitigation_types.yml` file. Each section should follow the same structure as the built-in mitigation types. The following section goes over the different parameters available for mitigation types, using *Blocking* as an example.
zh: 你可以通过向`MythicLib/mitigation_types.yml`文件添加新部分来创建自己的自定义缓解类型。每个部分应遵循与built-in缓解类型相同的结构。以下部分以*阻止*为例介绍可用于缓解类型的不同参数。

source: While you can certainly recreate similar *Mitigation Types* using other plugins or scripting solutions, MythicLib aims to provide an easy-to-use framework finetuned to RPG server use cases.
zh: 虽然你当然可以使用其他插件或脚本解决方案重新创建类似的“缓解类型”，但MythicLib旨在提供针对RPG服务器用例进行微调的easy-to-use框架。

source: Cooldown
zh: 冷却时间

source: The option `cooldown` indicates that such mitigation type has a cooldown. It cannot occur more frequently than once every X seconds, where X is the value returned by the formula. The default formula for *Blocking* is `3 * (1 - <stat.block_cooldown_reduction> / 100)`, meaning that the base cooldown is 3 seconds, but it can be reduced by the player's *Block Cooldown Reduction* stat.
zh: 选项`cooldown`指示此类缓解类型具有冷却时间。它发生的频率不能超过每 X 秒一次，其中 X 是公式返回的值。 *Blocking* 的默认公式是`3 * (1 - <stat.block_cooldown_reduction> / 100)`，这意味着基本冷却时间是3秒，但可以通过玩家的 *Block冷却时间Reduction*属性来减少。

source: Roll
zh: 卷

source: The option `roll` is a formula that returns the chance of successfully performing the mitigation. The formula should return a value between 0 and 1, where 0 means 0% chance and 1 means 100% chance. In the case of *Blocking*, the default formula is `<stat.block_rating> / 100`, meaning that if the player has 25% *Block Rating*, they have a 25% chance to block each incoming attack.
zh: 选项`roll`是一个返回成功执行缓解的机会的公式。该公式应返回0和1之间的值，其中0表示0%机会，1表示100%机会。在 *阻止* 的情况下，默认公式为`<stat.block_rating> / 100`，这意味着如果玩家具有25%*阻止评级*，则它们有25%机会阻止每个传入攻击。

source: Pre-Damage Script
zh: Pre-Damage脚本

source: The script `pre_damage` is executed before the mitigation is rolled for. It can be used to set up any necessary variables or conditions for the mitigation. In the case of *Blocking*, there is no pre-damage script by default, but you can add one if needed using the following syntax:
zh: 脚本`pre_damage`在缓解措施推出之前执行。它可用于设置任何必要的变量或缓解条件。对于 *Blocking*，默认情况下没有pre-damage脚本，但你可以根据需要使用以下语法添加一个脚本：

source: > Note that all built-in scripts used by mitigation types are all located in the `MythicLib/script/mitigation_types` config file. You can view and edit them as you wish.
zh: > 请注意，缓解类型使用的所有built-in脚本均位于`MythicLib/script/mitigation_types`配置文件中。你可以根据需要查看和编辑它们。

source: On-Damage Script
zh: On-Damage脚本

source: Last but not least, the script `on_damage` is executed when the mitigation successfully triggers. This script only executes if the following conditions are met:
zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，当缓解成功触发时，将执行脚本`on_damage`。该脚本仅在满足以下条件时执行：

source: the mitigation is not on cooldown,
zh: 缓解措施不在冷却时间上，

source: the mitigation roll was successful,
zh: 缓解滚动成功，

source: all conditions in the pre-damage script (if any) were met,
zh: 满足pre-damage脚本中的所有条件（如果有），

source: the `DamageMitigationEvent` Bukkit event was not cancelled by another plugin.
zh: `DamageMitigationEvent`Bukkit事件未被其他插件取消。

source: For *Blocking*, the default on-damage script is `mitigation_on_block`, which reduces the incoming damage by a percentage based on the player's *Block Power* stat.
zh: 对于*阻止*，默认的on-damage脚本是`mitigation_on_block`，它根据玩家的*阻止功率*属性减少传入伤害的百分比。

source: 🗡️ On-Hit Effects
zh: 🗡️On-Hit效果

source: *On-Hit Effects* are special effects that trigger when a player deals damage to another entity (either a monster or a player).
zh: *On-Hit效果* 是当玩家对另一个实体（怪物或玩家）造成伤害时触发的特殊效果。

source: For instance, *Skill* and *Weapon Critical Strikes* are considered on-hit effects. *Lifesteal*, which heals the attacker based on a percentage of the damage dealt, is another example of an on-hit effect. *Manasteal*, which restores mana to the attacker based on a percentage of the damage dealt, is also an on-hit effect.
zh: 例如，*技能* 和 *武器暴击* 被视为on-hit效果。 *吸血*根据造成的伤害百分比来治疗攻击者，这是on-hit效果的另一个例子。 *Manasteal*，根据造成的伤害百分比为攻击者恢复魔力，也是on-hit效果。

source: Most on-hit effects directly depend on numerical player stats, such as *Critical Strike Chance* or *Lifesteal Percentage*. In this page, we go over the built-in on-hit effects provided by MythicLib, as well as how to create custom ones.
zh: 大多数on-hit效果直接取决于数值玩家属性，例如*暴击几率*或*吸血百分比*。在本页中，我们将介绍MythicLib提供的built-inon-hit效果，以及如何创建自定义效果。

source: Builtin On-Hit Effects
zh: 内置On-Hit效果器

source: MythicLib comes with several on-hit effects built in, including:
zh: MythicLib内置了多种on-hit效果器，包括：

source: *Weapon* & *Skill Critical Strikes*
zh: *武器* & *技能暴击*

source: *Lifesteal*, *Skill Vampirism*
zh: *吸血*，*技能吸血鬼*

source: Custom On-Hit Effects
zh: 自定义On-Hit效果器

source: You can create your own custom on-hit effects by adding new sections to the `MythicLib/on_hit_effects.yml` file. Each section should follow the same structure as the built-in on-hit effects. The next section goes over the different parameters available for on-hit effects, using *Weapon Critical Strikes* as an example.
zh: 你可以通过向`MythicLib/on_hit_effects.yml`文件添加新部分来创建自己的自定义on-hit效果。每个部分应遵循与built-inon-hit效果相同的结构。下一节将介绍可用于on-hit效果的不同参数，以 *武器暴击* 为例。

source: While you can certainly recreate similar *On-Hit Effects* using other plugins or scripting solutions, MythicLib aims to provide an easy-to-use framework finetuned to RPG server use cases.
zh: 虽然你当然可以使用其他插件或脚本解决方案重新创建类似的 *On-Hit效果*，但MythicLib旨在提供针对RPG服务器用例进行微调的easy-to-use框架。

source: All on-hit effects are configured in the `MythicLib/on_hit_effects.yml` file. Each on-hit effect has its own section in the file, where you can customize its behavior and parameters. Let us go over the built-in config section for *Weapon Critical Strikes* as an example:
zh: 所有on-hit效果均在`MythicLib/on_hit_effects.yml`文件中配置。每个on-hit效果在文件中都有自己的部分，你可以在其中自定义其行为和参数。让我们以 *武器暴击* 的built-in配置部分为例：

source: The option `cooldown` indicates that such on-hit effect has a cooldown. It cannot occur more frequently than once every X seconds, where X is the value returned by the formula. The default formula for *Weapon Critical Strikes* is `3 * (1 - <stat.critical_strike_cooldown_reduction> / 100)`, meaning that the base cooldown is 3 seconds, but it can be reduced by the player's *Critical Strike Cooldown Reduction* stat.
zh: 选项`cooldown`表示此类on-hit效果具有冷却时间。它发生的频率不能超过每 X 秒一次，其中 X 是公式返回的值。 *武器暴击* 的默认公式是`3 * (1 - <stat.critical_strike_cooldown_reduction> / 100)`，这意味着基础冷却时间是3秒，但可以通过玩家的 *暴击冷却时间减少*属性。

source: This is an optional parameter. If you wish to disable the cooldown for an on-hit effect, simply delete the `cooldown` line or comment it out.
zh: 这是一个可选参数。如果你希望禁用冷却时间以获得on-hit效果，只需删除`cooldown`行或将其注释掉即可。

source: The option `roll` is a formula that returns the chance of successfully performing the on-hit effect. The formula should return a value between 0 and 1, where 0 means 0% chance and 1 means 100% chance. In the case of *Weapon Critical Strikes*, the default formula is `<stat.critical_strike_chance> / 100`, meaning that if the player has 25% *Critical Strike Chance*, they have a 25% chance to perform a weapon critical strike on each attack.
zh: 选项`roll`是一个公式，返回成功执行on-hit效果的机会。该公式应返回0和1之间的值，其中0表示0%机会，1表示100%机会。对于 *武器暴击*，默认公式为`<stat.critical_strike_chance> / 100`，这意味着如果玩家具有25%*暴击几率*，则它们有25%机会执行武器每次攻击时为暴击。

source: This is an optional parameter. If you wish for the on-hit effect to always trigger (when not on cooldown), simply set the value to `1`.
zh: 这是一个可选参数。如果你希望on-hit效果始终触发（不在冷却时间上时），只需将该值设置为`1`即可。

source: Pre-Attack Script
zh: Pre-Attack脚本

source: The script `pre_attack` is executed before the on-hit effect is rolled for. It can be used to set up any necessary variables or conditions for the on-hit effect. In the case of *Weapon Critical Strikes*, the default script is `skill_crit_script_check`, which makes sure that the attack contains either *Weapon* or *Unarmed* damage, as weapon crits only apply on these damage types.
zh: 在滚动on-hit效果之前执行脚本`pre_attack`。它可用于为on-hit效果设置任何必要的变量或条件。对于 *武器暴击*，默认脚本是`skill_crit_script_check`，这确保攻击包含 *武器* 或 *徒手* 伤害，因为武器暴击仅适用于这些伤害类型。

source: This is an optional parameter. If you do not need any pre-attack setup, you can simply omit the `pre_attack` line.
zh: 这是一个可选参数。如果你不需要任何pre-attack设置，则可以简单地省略`pre_attack`行。

source: > Note that all built-in scripts used by on-hit effects are all located in the `MythicLib/script/on_hit_effects` config file. You can view and edit them as you wish.
zh: > 请注意，on-hit效果使用的所有built-in脚本均位于`MythicLib/script/on_hit_effects`配置文件中。你可以根据需要查看和编辑它们。

source: Attack Script
zh: 攻击脚本

source: Last but not least, the script `on_attack` is executed when the on-hit effect successfully triggers. This script only executes if the following conditions are met:
zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，当on-hit效果成功触发时，将执行脚本`on_attack`。该脚本仅在满足以下条件时执行：

source: the on-hit effect is not on cooldown,
zh: on-hit效果不适用于冷却时间，

source: the roll check is successful,
zh: 滚动检查成功，

source: any conditions specified in the `pre_attack` script are met,
zh: 满足`pre_attack`脚本中指定的任何条件，

source: the Bukkit event `OnHitEffectEvent` is not cancelled by any plugin.
zh: Bukkit事件`OnHitEffectEvent`不会被任何插件取消。

source: In the case of *Weapon Critical Strikes*, the default script is `weapon_crit_script`, which applies the critical strike damage multiplier to the attack.
zh: 对于 *武器暴击*，默认脚本是`weapon_crit_script`，它将暴击伤害乘数应用于攻击。

source: Skip Event
zh: 跳过事件

source: This is an optional parameter for performance. Set `skip_event` to `true` to skip firing the `OnHitEffectEvent` Bukkit event when this on-hit effect triggers. This way, this on-hit event cannot be listened to or cancelled by any plugin.
zh: 这是性能的可选参数。将`skip_event`设置为`true`，以在该on-hit效果触发时跳过触发`OnHitEffectEvent`Bukkit事件。这样，这个on-hit事件就无法被任何插件监听或取消。

source: MMOItems and MMOCore share the same stat system. Any stat that you gain through an MMOItems item, MMOCore class, or item placed inside a MMOInventory inventory, will propagate to all MMO plugins.
zh: MMOItems和MMOCore共享相同的属性系统。你通过放置在MMOInventory物品栏内的MMOItems物品、MMOCore职业或物品获得的任何属性都将传播到所有 MMO 插件。

source: In this page, we look at the `MythicLib/stats.yml` config file. Unless specified otherwise, all YML snippets are to be used inside of this config file.
zh: 在此页面中，我们查看`MythicLib/stats.yml`配置文件。除非另有指定，否则所有 YML 片段都将在此配置文件内使用。

source: Temporary Stats
zh: 临时属性

source: Temporary stats, or *stat modifiers*, are stats boosts/debuffs that are given to players for a limited/unlimited amount of time. In either way, these stats are removed when the server restarts.
zh: 临时属性或 *属性修正器* 是在有限/无限时间内给予玩家的属性增强/减益。无论哪种方式，这些属性都会在服务器重新启动时删除。

source: Using a script
zh: 使用脚本

source: Note that you can give temporary stats to players using the `add_stat` script mechanic. You will find more information on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/buffs#add-temporary-stats). These stats will be removed when the server restarts.
zh: 请注意，你可以使用`add_stat`脚本机制将临时属性赋予玩家。你可以在 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/buffs#add-temporary-stats)上找到更多信息。当服务器重新启动时，这些属性将被删除。

source: The easiest way to provide temporary stats to players is through commands.
zh: 向玩家提供临时属性的最简单方法是通过命令。

source: Using the `add` subcommand, you can provide a stat modifier to a player.
zh: 使用`add`子命令，你可以将属性修正器提供给玩家。

source: If you provide a duration through the `duration` parameter (in ticks), the stat will be temporary and removed after that time.
zh: 如果你通过`duration`参数提供持续时间（以刻为单位），则属性将是临时的并在该时间之后删除。

source: If you provide a `key`, you can later remove this stat modifier using the `remove` subcommand. If you do not provide any, it will use the default key `default`.
zh: 如果你提供`key`，则稍后可以使用`remove`子命令删除此属性修正器。如果你不提供任何密钥，它将使用默认密钥`default`。

source: If you set `unique` to true, only one modifier with the same key will be active at a time; adding a new one will replace the previous one. This is useful for buffs that you want to refresh periodically.
zh: 如果将`unique`设置为true，则一次只有一个具有相同键的修改器会处于活动状态；添加新的将取代先前的。这对于你想要定期刷新的增益效果非常有用。

source: > **Example**

> The following command provides a flat +10 Attack Damage stat to the player `Notch` for 5 seconds (100 ticks), using the key `my_custom_buff`. If you execute the same command again, it will not override the previous one since `unique` is set to false, and it will stack with itself.
zh: > 以下命令使用密钥`my_custom_buff`向玩家`Notch`提供 Flat +10攻击伤害属性持续5秒（100刻）。如果再次执行相同的命令，它不会覆盖前一个命令，因为`unique`设置为false，并且它会与自身堆栈。

source: Using the `clear` subcommand, you can remove all stat modifiers with the associated `key` from a player.
zh: 使用`clear`子命令，你可以从玩家中删除所有属性修正器以及关联的`key`。

source: > The following command removes all stat modifiers with the key `my_custom_buff` from the player `Notch`.
zh: > 以下命令从玩家`Notch`中删除带有密钥`my_custom_buff`的所有属性修正器。

source: Base Stat Values
zh: 属性基本值

source: Modifying the base value of a stat inside `MythicLib/stats.yml` has the same effect as applying a permanent flat stat buff or debuff to the player. If your MMOCore class has 20 base *Max Health*, and you set the base value of the *Max Health* stat to 10, the resulting *Max Health* is `10 + 20 = 30`.
zh: 修改`MythicLib/stats.yml`内的属性的基值与对玩家应用永久平坦属性增益效果或减益效果相同。如果你的MMOCore职业具有20基数 *最大生命值* ，并且你将 *最大生命值*属性的基数设置为10，则结果 *最大生命值* 为`10 + 20 = 30`。

source: This feature is most useful when you want to adjust the base stat values of all players on your server by a flat amount. If you are using MMOCore, you might not need this feature at all, as you may find it easier to simply edit the base stat values of your classes.
zh: 当你想要按固定量调整服务器上所有玩家的基本属性值时，此功能最有用。如果你使用的是MMOCore，你可能根本不需要此功能，因为你可能会发现简单地编辑职业的基本属性值会更容易。

source: Note that default Minecraft stats like *Max Health*, *Armor*, *Attack Damage*, and *Attack Speed* naturally have non-zero base values defined by vanilla Minecraft. For instance, *Max Health* has a base value of 20, *Movement Speed* is 0.1, *Attack Speed* is 4, *Attack Damage* is 1, etc. These vanilla base values **add up to** the base values specified in this configuration file; they are not overridden by them.
zh: 请注意，默认的Minecraft属性，如 *最大生命值*、*护甲*、*攻击伤害* 和 *攻击速度* 自然具有由原版Minecraft定义的non-zero基值。例如， *最大生命值* 的基值为20， *移动速度* 为0.1， *攻击速度* 为4， *攻击伤害* 为1等。这些原版基值**合计**此配置文件中指定的基值；它们不会被它们所覆盖。

source: Note that the base stat values specified inside `MMOCore/stats.yml` override the vanilla base stat values, while the MythicLib base stat values act as **stat value adjustments (offsets)**. Lastly, stat formulas provided inside [MMOCore class configs](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes#class-stats) override formulas provided inside `MMOCore/stats.yml`.
zh: 请注意，`MMOCore/stats.yml`内部指定的基本属性值会覆盖原版基本属性值，而MythicLib基本属性值充当 **属性值调整（偏移）**。最后，[MMOCore职业配置](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes#class-stats)中提供的属性公式覆盖`MMOCore/stats.yml`中提供的公式。

source: Stat Proxies
zh: 属性代理

source: Stat proxies are a very useful feature, that allows you to create **stats that provide other stats**. For instance, you can create a *Strength* stat that, for every point, increases *Max Health* by 4% and *Atk Damage* by 1 point.
zh: 属性代理是一个非常有用的功能，它允许你创建提供其他属性** 的 **属性**。例如，你可以创建一个*强度*属性，对于每个点，*最大生命值* 增加4%点，*攻击力伤害* 增加1点。

source: If you are running MMOCore, you might recognize similarities with [attributes](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/attributes). You would not be wrong, as MMOCore attributes are internally implemented using stat proxies. Stat proxies can be seen as an extension of MMOCore attributes, while MMOCore attributes can be thought of as a user-friendly way to interact with stat proxies.
zh: 如果使用 MMOCore，你可能会发现它与[基础属性](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/attributes)相似。这是因为 MMOCore 的基础属性在内部就是通过属性代理实现的。属性代理可以看作 MMOCore 基础属性的扩展，而基础属性则为玩家提供了更容易使用属性代理的方式。

source: Let us take a look at the following YML snippet, which you will find inside the `MythicLib/stats.yml` config file.
zh: 让我们看一下以下 YML 片段，你可以在`MythicLib/stats.yml`配置文件中找到该片段。

source: This syntax defines two stat proxies. The first one resembles the *Strength* stat we mentionned earlier. This stat proxy is configured so that, each point in the `POWER` stat automatically provides +2% *Max Health* and +1% *Atk Damage*.
zh: 此语法定义两个属性代理。第一个类似于我们之前提到的*强度*属性。此属性代理经过配置，以便`POWER`属性中的每个点自动提供 +2%*最大生命值* 和 +1%*Atk Damage*。

source: `multiplier` is the amount of stat points transferred to the target stat, for each point in the source stat. `type` can be set to `FLAT` for a flat bonus, `RELATIVE` for a %-based bonus or `COMPOUND` for a geometric/compound %-based bonus. When type is set to `RELATIVE` or `COMPOUND`, `multiplier` should be provided as a percent (that is, MythicLib will multiply the given value by `1/100` to express it as a scalar).
zh: `multiplier`是对于源属性中的每个点，传输到目标属性的属性点的数量。`type`可以设置为`FLAT`以获得固定奖金，`RELATIVE`为基于百分比的奖金或`COMPOUND`为基于几何/复合百分比的奖金。当 type 设置为`RELATIVE`或`COMPOUND`时，`multiplier`应以百分比形式提供（即MythicLib会将给定值乘以`1/100`以将其表示为标量）。

source: %-Based Stats
zh: 基于%的属性

source: The second proxy defined by the snippet above presents another potential use case for stat proxies. In case a specific stat, say `MAX_HEALTH`, as no %-stat equivalent in MMOItems, you can create an intermediate/proxy stat, that transforms linear buffs to the `MAX_HEALTH_PERCENT` stat into %-based buffs to the `MAX_HEALTH` stat.
zh: 上面的代码片段定义的第二个代理提供了属性代理的另一个潜在用例。如果是特定的属性，比如`MAX_HEALTH`，因为MMOItems中没有 %-属性等效项，你可以创建一个中间/代理属性，它将线性增益效果转换为`MAX_HEALTH_PERCENT`属性到基于%的增益效果到`MAX_HEALTH`属性。

zh: > 目前仅适用于MythicLib和MMOCore。

source: MMO plugins allow you to edit basic information of native plugin commands, including their name, description, usage, aliases and permission. All of these options are editable in the `commands.yml` file located in the main plugin folder.
zh: MMO 插件允许你编辑本机插件命令的基本信息，包括名称、描述、用法、别名和权限。所有这些选项都可以在位于主插件文件夹中的`commands.yml`文件中进行编辑。

source: The `main` option defines the command name, or label. If set to `player`, players have to type `/player` to execute the command. The `aliases` option allows you to define alternative labels for the same command. In the example above, players can also type `/p` or `/profile` to execute the same command as `/player`.
zh: `main`选项定义命令名称或标签。如果设置为`player`，则玩家必须键入`/player`才能执行命令。`aliases`选项允许你为同一命令定义替代标签。在上面的示例中，玩家还可以键入`/p`或`/profile`来执行与`/player`相同的命令。

source: The `permission` option defines the permission required to execute the command. In the example above, only players with the `mmocore.profile` permission can execute the `/player` command.

source: Command Verbose
zh: 命令详细

source: In the same config file, you can also define a `verbose` level for each command. This option allows you to control where the command execution messages are sent. There are multiple verbose levels available:
zh: 在同一个配置文件中，你还可以为每个命令定义`verbose`等级。此选项允许你控制命令执行消息的发送位置。有多个可用的详细等级：

zh: |`ALL`|消息被发送到玩家和控制台。 |

source: | `PLAYER` | Messages are only sent to the player executing the command. This mode avoids console spam when using commands like `/ml stat add`. |

source: | `NONE` | No messages are sent. |
zh: |`NONE`|没有发送任何消息。 |

source: Removing damage particles
zh: 去除损坏颗粒

source: Some servers use very high damage values which can summon way too many damage particles on the client side. This can cause FPS drops and deeply lower user experience. In order to fix that we've integrated a damage particle cap in MythicLib which lets you control the amount of damage particles displayed. Head to the MythicLib `config.yml` file:
zh: 一些服务器使用非常高的伤害值，这可能会在客户端召唤太多的伤害粒子。这可能会导致 FPS 下降并严重降低用户体验。为了解决这个问题，我们在MythicLib中集成了一个伤害粒子上限，它可以让你控制显示的伤害粒子数量。前往MythicLib`config.yml`文件：

source: Enable this option by toggling on the `enabled` option and input the value you want for the `max-per-tick` option. This corresponds to the **maximum amount of particles emitted by one entity in ONE tick**.
zh: 通过切换`enabled`选项来启用此选项，并输入`max-per-tick`选项所需的值。这对应于**一个实体在一个刻内发射的粒子的最大数量**。

source: Health Scale
zh: 生命值秤

source: Health scaling is a small sized RPG feature which makes the player health bar always display the same amount of hearts (while still having extra max. health). When scaling your health to 40 (default value), the player health bar will always display 2 rows (`2 * 20`) of hearts.
zh: 生命值缩放是RPG的一项小功能，它使玩家生命条始终显示相同数量的心（同时仍具有额外的最大生命值）。当你的生命值缩放至40（默认值）时，玩家生命值栏将始终显示2行（`2 * 20`）红心。

source: 💧 Mana & Stamina
zh: 💧魔力&耐力

source: MMOItems and MMOCore use mana and stamina for item/skill resource costs. Many RPG plugins that implement Mana and/or Stamina are natively supported by the MMO plugins. Please see [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#rpg-plugins) for the full list of supported plugins.
zh: MMOItems和MMOCore使用魔力和耐力来计算物品/技能资源成本。 MMO 插件本身支持许多实现魔力和/或耐力的RPG插件。请参阅[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#rpg-plugins)以获取受支持插件的完整列表。

source: In order to choose your mana/stamina plugin, go to your MythicLib `config.yml` and set the `mana-plugin` option.
zh: 要选择魔力/耐力插件，请转到MythicLib`config.yml`并设置`mana-plugin`选项。

source: Built-in Solution
zh: Built-in解决方案

source: If you are not using any RPG plugin, you can stick to the built-in mana and stamina module that comes with MythicLib. This module/addon adds two resources, Mana and Stamina, as well as the following stats:
zh: 如果你没有使用任何RPG插件，你可以坚持使用MythicLib附带的built-in魔力和耐力模块。此模块/插件添加了两个资源，魔力和耐力，以及以下属性：

source: *Mana and Stamina Regeneration*, which is the amount of resource passively regenerated every second,
zh: *魔力和耐力再生*，即每秒被动再生的资源量，

source: *Max Mana and Stamina*, which is the maximum amount of resource a player can have.
zh: *Max魔力和耐力*，这是玩家可以拥有的最大资源量。

source: This module also supports MMOProfiles. When switching profiles, mana and stamina are temporarily stored. When switching back to a previously opened profile, the old mana and stamina values are restored.
zh: 该模块还支持MMOProfiles。切换档案时，临时存储魔力和耐力。当切换回之前打开的档案时，旧的魔力和耐力值将恢复。

zh: 启用后，你可以在MythicLib`config.yml`的`builtin_mana`配置部分中编辑魔力/耐力选项。请注意，当使用任何其他魔力插件时，这些选项是无用的。

source: 💬 Player Messages
zh: 💬玩家消息

source: MythicLib provides unified syntax for messages sent to players by all MMO plugins.
zh: MythicLib为所有 MMO 插件发送到玩家的消息提供统一的语法。

source: Most MMO plugins have a `messages.yml` config file where you can edit messages sent by the plugin. Below is part of the `MMOCore/messages.yml` config file.
zh: 大多数 MMO 插件都有一个`messages.yml`配置文件，你可以在其中编辑插件发送的消息。以下是`MMOCore/messages.yml`配置文件的一部分。

source: In the next sections, we will take the example of the MMOCore message sent when a player levels up their main class (`level-up`) but this is applicable to any message from any MMO plugin.
zh: 在接下来的部分中，我们将以玩家等级上升到其主职业(`level-up`) 时发送的MMOCore消息为例，但这适用于来自任何 MMO 插件的任何消息。

source: Basic Syntax
zh: 基本语法

source: This sends one line of text to the player chat.
zh: 这将向玩家聊天发送一行文本。

source: This sends multiple lines of text to the player chat. As you can see, `format` can either be text or a list of texts.
zh: 这会将多行文本发送到玩家聊天。如你所见，`format`可以是文本，也可以是文本列表。

source: Disable a message
zh: 禁用消息

source: If you want to disable a message, say `level-up`, so that nothing is sent to the player when they level up, use the following syntax:
zh: 如果要禁用消息（例如`level-up`），以便在升级时不会向玩家发送任何消息，请使用以下语法：

source: Send to action bar
zh: 发送到动作栏

source: If you want to send the message to the player's action bar instead, set `action-bar` to `true`.
zh: 如果你想将消息发送到玩家的动作栏，请将`action-bar`设置为`true`。

source: Extra options
zh: 额外选项

source: In MythicLib, the action bar is shared by all MMO plugins. To avoid action bar messages colliding with each other, we implemented a basic *message priority & timeout* system.
zh: 在MythicLib中，动作栏被所有 MMO 插件共享。为了避免动作栏消息相互冲突，我们实现了一个基本的*消息优先级和超时*系统。

source: Every message has a priority and a duration, which are both positive integers. One-time messages (such as level-up or waypoint use messages) usually have high priority, and passive messages like MMOCore player info and action bars usually have low priorities.
zh: 每条消息都有一个优先级和持续时间，它们都是正整数。One-time消息（例如level-up或航点使用消息）通常具有高优先级，而被动消息（例如MMOCore玩家信息和动作栏）通常具有低优先级。

source: When multiple messages are sent simultaneously to the same player, only the message with highest priority will show on the player's action bar. The high-priority message will temporarily "hide" the message with low priority, for a set period of time (the message duration).
zh: 当多条消息同时发送到同一个玩家时，只有具有最高优先级的消息才会显示在玩家的动作栏上。high-priority消息将在设定的时间段（消息持续时间）内暂时“隐藏”低优先级的消息。

source: The message priority and duration can be edited using the following syntax
zh: 可以使用以下语法编辑消息优先级和持续时间

source: The MMOCore player information action bar runs on priority `LOW`, set to `20`. The MMOCore skill casting action bars run on priority `NORMAL` set to `30`.
zh: MMOCore玩家信息动作栏在优先级`LOW`上运行，设置为`20`。MMOCore技能施放动作栏在设置为`30`的优先级`NORMAL`上运行。

source: Play a sound
zh: 播放声音

source: Sounds can be played when the message is sent to the player. The basic syntax is `<sound_name>,<pitch>,<volume>`. The sound name can be one of the following:
zh: 消息发送到玩家时可以播放声音。基本语法是`<sound_name>,<pitch>,<volume>`。声音名称可以是以下之一：

source: a [Bukkit sound](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html),
zh: [Bukkit声音](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html)，

source: a custom sound provided by a resource pack, like `itemsadder:sound_id`,
zh: 资源包提供的自定义声音，例如`itemsadder:sound_id`，

source: a Minecraft [vanilla sound](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Sounds.json/Java_Edition_values) like `minecraft:entity.zombie.ambient`.
zh: Minecraft[原版声音](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Sounds.json/Java_Edition_values)类似于`minecraft:entity.zombie.ambient`。

source: If you want to set the pitch and volume to 1, you can simply use `<sound_name>`. Pitch ranges from 0.5 (low pitch) to 2 (high pitch) and defaults to 1. Volume defaults to 1.
zh: 如果你想将音调和音量设置为1，则只需使用`<sound_name>`即可。音高范围从0.5（低音）到2（高音），默认为1。音量默认为1。

source: If you prefer YML syntax over comma-separated values, you can also use the following syntax:
zh: 如果你更喜欢 YML 语法而不是comma-separated值，你还可以使用以下语法：

source: You can even remove the `format` field and only send a sound to the player, with no text sent to the player chat or action bar.
zh: 你甚至可以删除`format`字段，只向玩家发送声音，而不向玩家聊天或动作栏发送文本。

source: Call a MythicLib script
zh: 调用MythicLib脚本

source: You can run a MythicLib script when a message is sent to a player. For instance, MythicLib comes with a script named `mmocore_level_up_effect` which displays a small particle effect around the player. By default, it is called when the player levels up either their main class or a profession.
zh: 当消息发送到玩家时，你可以运行MythicLib脚本。例如，MythicLib附带一个名为`mmocore_level_up_effect`的脚本，该脚本在玩家周围显示小粒子效果。默认情况下，当玩家等级启动其主职业或副职业时，会调用它。

source: This is the code of the `mmocore_level_up_effect` script, which can be found in the `MythicLib/script/mmocore_scripts.yml` file.
zh: 这是`mmocore_level_up_effect`脚本的代码，可以在`MythicLib/script/mmocore_scripts.yml`文件中找到。

source: 📌 Player Modifiers
zh: 📌玩家修饰符

source: > This feature is not available yet. It will be used in the future for MMOCore/profession exp tables, MMOItems set bonuses, MMOCore skill trees, etc.
zh: > 此功能尚不可用。将来将用于MMOCore/副职业经验牌桌、MMOItems套装奖金、MMOCore技能树等。

source: A player modifier can be any type of passive behaviour that modifies your player to make it stronger or weaker. Stat modifiers, skills, permanent potion effects are all considered player modifiers and can be granted to players using items, full item set bonuses, MMOCore parties, MMOCore player classes...
zh: 玩家修改器可以是任何类型的被动行为，可以修改你的玩家以使其更强或更弱。属性修正器、技能、永久药水效果均被视为玩家修饰符，并且可以使用物品、全部物品套装奖金、MMOCore队伍、MMOCore授予玩家玩家职业...

source: | Player Modifier | Description | Identifier |
zh: |玩家修改器 |描述 |标识符 |

source: | Stat modifier | Modifies a player stat value | `stat` |
zh: |属性修正器|修改玩家属性值 |`stat`|

source: | Attribute modifier | Modifies the value of a MMOCore attribute | `attribute` |
zh: |基础属性修改器 |修改MMOCore基础属性| 的值`attribute`|

source: | Skill | Gives the player some triggerable skill | `skill` |
zh: |技能|为玩家提供一些可触发的技能|`skill`|

source: | Potion Effect | A permanent potion effect like Speed II | `potion` |
zh: |药水效果|像 Speed II 这样的永久药水效果 |`potion`|

source: | Particle Effect | A permanent particle effect | `particle` |
zh: |粒子效果|永久粒子效果|`particle`|

source: When configuring MMOItems or MMOCore you will sometimes be asked to define player modifiers in specific scenarios, like when creating item sets in MMOItems and defining what modifiers to give the player when wearing 3 items from the same set.
zh: 配置MMOItems或MMOCore时，有时会要求你在特定场景中定义玩家修饰符，例如在MMOItems中创建物品套装时，以及定义在佩戴同一组中的3物品时为玩家提供哪些修饰符。

source: Stat Modifiers
zh: 属性修正器

source: When applied onto a player, a stat modifier increases the value of a player stat by a certain amount. It can be either a flat stat modifier (+10 Atk Dmg) or a multiplicative modifier (+10% Atk Dmg) which scales on the initial player's stat value.
zh: 当应用于玩家时，属性修正器会使玩家属性的值增加一定量。它可以是平坦的属性修正器(+10Atk Dmg) 或乘法修饰符 (+10%Atk Dmg)，其按初始玩家的属性值缩放。

source: Skills are a special type of player modifiers. Read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro) to learn more about skills in the MMO plugins.
zh: 技能是玩家修饰符的特殊类型。阅读 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro)，了解有关 MMO 插件中的技能的更多信息。

source: 🎨 GUI Syntax
zh: 🎨GUI语法

source: MythicLib provides unified syntax for chest UI inventories. This includes MMOItems crafting stations, the MMOProfiles profile selection UI, and all MMOCore UIs including player stats, waypoints, party & friends, class selection, etc.
zh: MythicLib为宝箱 UI物品栏提供统一语法。这包括MMOItems合成站、MMOProfiles档案选择 UI 以及所有MMOCoreUI，包括玩家属性、航点、队伍和朋友、职业选择等。

source: GUI plugin configs are located inside the `gui` or `language/gui` folder.
zh: GUI插件配置位于`gui`或`language/gui`文件夹内。

source: In this tutorial, we will be focusing on the MMOCore attributes menu.
zh: 在本教程中，我们将重点关注MMOCore基础属性菜单。

source: <summary>Original Config</summary>
zh: <summary>原始配置</summary>

source: General Options
zh: 一般选项

source: You can edit the general GUI settings like its name and slots.
zh: 你可以编辑常规GUI设置，例如其名称和插槽。

source: Notice how the config sections that fall under the `items` section share very similar properties: `name` (the item display name), `lore` (the item description/lore), `item` (the item material), `slots` (where the item is placed in the inventory, it can be a list) and `function` (what the item does). These can (and should) all be edited to your needs.
zh: 请注意`items`部分下的配置部分如何共享非常相似的属性：`name`（物品显示名称）、`lore`（物品描述/描述）、`item`（物品材料）、`slots`（其中物品放置在物品栏中，它可以是一个列表）和`function`（物品的作用）。这些都可以（并且应该）根据你的需要进行编辑。

source: Editing Item Slots
zh: 编辑物品插槽

source: If you want to have your item displayed on multiple slots, use the following syntax:
zh: 如果你想让物品显示在多个插槽上，请使用以下语法：

source: `function` tells MythicLib what the item does when clicked, and what placeholders to apply in the item lore. A function that works inside the MMOCore attribute menu will not work inside the MMOProfiles profile selection menu. Each GUI comes with its own set of built-in item functions.
zh: `function`告诉MythicLib单击时物品会做什么，以及占位符在物品描述中应用什么。在MMOCore基础属性菜单中工作的功能在MMOProfiles档案选择菜单中不起作用。每个GUI都有自己的一套内置物品功能。

source: In general, you don't really want to change it, unless you are adding a generic item function like a *Go Back* or *Close* button. You can edit the item visuals as much as you want, but changing the function will change the item behavior and the placeholders that are applied to it, so make sure you know what you are doing before editing it.
zh: 一般来说，你并不真的想更改它，除非你要添加通用物品功能，例如“返回”或“关闭”按钮。你可以根据需要编辑物品视觉效果，但更改功能将更改物品行为以及应用于它的占位符，因此在编辑之前请确保你知道自己在做什么。

source: In the following example, the item uses a builtin `attribute_<attribute_name>` function that applies placeholders and click handlers related to the MMOCore player attribute.
zh: 在以下示例中，物品使用内置`attribute_<attribute_name>`函数，该函数应用与MMOCore玩家基础属性相关的占位符和点击处理程序。

source: Lore Placeholders
zh: 描述占位符

source: Choosing the item function unlocks specific placeholders that you can use inside the item name and lore. For instance, the `attribute_<attribute_name>` function inside the MMOCore attribute menu unlocks the following placeholders:
zh: 选择物品函数会解锁特定的占位符，你可以在物品名称和描述中使用它。例如，MMOCore基础属性菜单中的`attribute_<attribute_name>`函数解锁以下占位符：

source: | `{spent}` | Amount of attribute points spent by the player in that attribute |
zh: |`{spent}`|玩家在该基础属性中花费的基础属性点金额 |

source: | `{max}` | Maximum amount of attribute points you may spend in that attribute |
zh: |`{max}`|你可以在该基础属性中花费的最大金额基础属性点|

source: | `{name}` | Attribute name |
zh: |`{name}`|基础属性名称 |

source: | `{current}` | The current attribute of the player. Takes into account modifiers from MMOItems and other plugins. |
zh: |`{current}`|目前的基础属性为玩家。考虑到MMOItems和其他插件的修饰符。 |

source: | `{buff_<stat>}` | Buff granted for each point spent in that attribute. |
zh: |`{buff_<stat>}`|增益效果授予在该基础属性中花费的每一点。 |

source: | `{total_<stat>}` | Total buff granted by all the points spent in that attribute (the product of `{spent}` and `{buff_xxx}`). |
zh: |`{total_<stat>}`|基础属性中花费的所有积分所授予的总计增益效果（`{spent}`和`{buff_xxx}`的乘积）。 |

source: Clickable Items
zh: 可点击物品

source: If you don't specify any function for an item, you can provide a [MythicLib script](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/intro) to be executed when the item is clicked, using the following syntax:
