source: Instead of a list of mechanics, you can also provide the name of a MythicLib script.
zh: 你还可以提供MythicLib脚本的名称，而不是机制列表。

source: 🐜 Reporting a bug
zh: 🐜 报告错误

source: With the important number of plugin users it is more important than ever to spend some time on properly drafting issue tickets. Even with limited config/dev experience, most of the following instructions will take you at most a few minutes of your time, and might spare you and the support & dev team several hours.
zh: 由于插件用户数量庞大，花一些时间正确起草问题单比以往任何时候都更加重要。即使你的配置/开发经验有限，以下大多数说明最多也只会花费你几分钟的时间，并且可能会为你和支持与开发团队节省几个小时的时间。

source: > Do not use Gitlab tickets for support requests. Your ticket will be closed and you will be asked to join the [Discord](https://phoenixdevt.fr/discord) server for community & staff assistance.
zh: > 请勿使用Gitlab票证来请求支持。你的票证将被关闭，并且你将被要求加入 [Discord](https://phoenixdevt.fr/discord)服务器以获得社区和工作人员帮助。

source: Use up-to-date plugin builds
zh: 使用up-to-date插件构建

source: Unless staff specifically told you to temporarily downgrade to a lower plugin version, always make sure you are using the latest version available for MythicLib, MMOItems, MMOCore **AND** MythicMobs. MythicLib is a hard dependency for any MMO plugin and also needs to be kept up-to-date. Due to plugin code dependencies and frequent code updates, you might have to simultaneously update all of the MMO plugins. These plugin requirements are **ALWAYS** indicated in the plugin changelogs.
zh: 除非工作人员特别告诉你暂时降级到较低的插件版本，否则请始终确保你使用的是MythicLib、MMOItems、MMOCore** 和 **MythicMobs可用的最新版本。MythicLib是任何 MMO 插件的硬依赖项，也需要保留up-to-date。由于插件代码依赖性和频繁的代码更新，你可能必须同时更新所有 MMO 插件。这些插件要求**始终**在插件更改日志中指出。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/spigot_changelog.UYEhkzg0.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/spigot_changelog.UYEhkzg0.png)

source: When using development builds (available on the official website), keep in mind there might be several weeks/months worth of work between the latest dev build and spigot release. Therefore, **when using a dev build for any of the MMO plugins, you have to use dev builds for all the plugins simultaneously**. More information [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/faq#keep-mythiclib-up-to-date).
zh: 使用开发版本（可在官方网站上找到）时，请记住，最新的开发版本和 spigot 版本之间可能需要数周/数月的工作时间。因此，**当对任何 MMO 插件使用开发版本时，你必须同时对所有插件使用开发版本**。更多信息[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/faq#keep-mythiclib-up-to-date)。

source: Look for your issue in the [Frequent Issues](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/faq) wiki page
zh: 在 [常见问题](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/faq)wiki 页面] 中查找你的问题

source: There are bugs due to your specific server or plugin configuration which you can fix on your own. This will not only save you some time waiting for an answer on the Discord server, but this will also save us some time.
zh: 由于你的特定服务器或插件配置而存在错误，你可以自行修复。这不仅可以节省你在Discord服务器上等待答复的时间，而且也可以节省我们的一些时间。

source: Look for similar issues in the [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mythiclib/-/issues)
zh: 在 [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mythiclib/-/issues)] 中查找类似问题

source: All closed issue tickets are archived, though you can still access them. Look for similar issues that have already been solved by other users, you might find your solution there. If you are reporting an existing issue, look for existing open tickets and provide more information there in order to reduce duplicates. Otherwise, open a new ticket!
zh: 所有已关闭的问题票证均已存档，但你仍然可以访问它们。查找其他用户已经解决的类似问题，你可能会在那里找到你的解决方案。如果你要报告现有问题，请查找现有的未处理票证并提供更多信息，以减少重复。否则，请开一张新票！

source: Read your console error logs
zh: 阅读你的控制台错误日志

source: This might sound dumb but if everyone read plugin error logs the *Use up-to-date plugin builds* section would be pretty much useless, as every time a startup bug occurs with any plugin, Bukkit displays `[..] [Server thread/ERROR]: Error occurred while enabling ... (Is it up to date?)` in the console.
zh: 这可能听起来很愚蠢，但如果每个人都阅读插件错误日志，*使用up-to-date插件构建*部分将几乎毫无用处，因为每次任何插件发生启动错误时，Bukkit都会在控制台中显示`[..] [Server thread/ERROR]: Error occurred while enabling ... (Is it up to date?)`。

source: While most of the time error logs are 99% stack trace which you won't be able to read, error messages developers leave here and there might help you fix your issue on your own.
zh: 虽然大多数情况下错误日志是你无法读取的99%堆栈跟踪，但开发人员留下的错误消息可能会帮助你自行解决问题。

source: Something you should do every time when seeing a plugin error stack trace is use CTRL+F and look for **plugin startup error logs** which always start with `Error occurred while enabling ...`. If you see any of these startup errors, you are pretty much guaranteed the plugin will NOT function properly as it failed to enable, given your server and plugin configurations. These startup issues should be reported in priority if you don't see them in the *Frequent Issues* wiki page.
zh: 每次看到插件错误堆栈跟踪时，你应该做的事情是使用 CTRL+F 并查找始终以`Error occurred while enabling ...`开头的 **插件启动错误日志**。如果你看到任何这些启动错误，则几乎可以保证该插件将无法正常运行，因为它无法启用，给定你的服务器和插件配置。如果你在*常见问题* wiki 页面中没有看到这些启动问题，则应优先报告这些问题。

source: How to report a bug
zh: 如何报告错误

source: If all of this didn't help you can open an issue ticket on Gitlab, or come talk to us on our Discord server as this could definitely be a plugin bug. When reporting an issue, please try to provide as much information as possible:
zh: 如果所有这些都没有帮助你可以在Gitlab上打开问题单，或者在我们的Discord服务器上与我们交谈，因为这绝对可能是插件错误。报告问题时，请尝试提供尽可能多的信息：

source: Provide a concise description of your problem
zh: 简要描述你的问题

source: Find an (easy) way to reproduce your issue and provide the steps
zh: 找到一种（简单）方法来重现你的问题并提供步骤

source: Pastebin relevant server logs (specific startup issues or full logs if you're unsure)
zh: Pastebin 相关服务器日志（具体启动问题或完整日志，如果你不确定）

source: Provide MMO/Mythic plugin builds used ("All latest spigot builds" or "All latest dev builds" is sufficient)
zh: 提供使用的 MMO/Mythic 插件版本（“所有最新的 spigot 版本”或“所有最新的开发版本”就足够了）

source: Provide any related plugin configuration file (MMOItems item configs, MMOCore class config, ML/MI/MM skill configs etc.)
zh: 提供任何相关的插件配置文件（MMOItems物品配置、MMOCore职业配置、ML/MI/MM技能配置等）

source: What you can do to make our lives easier:
zh: 你可以做些什么来让我们的生活更轻松：

source: Provide videos or screenshots; these are definitely appreciated when reproducing or describing complex issues.
zh: 提供视频或截图；在重现或描述复杂问题时，这些肯定会受到赞赏。

source: Give the plugin a try on a fresh server setup. This will wipe out most of the issues due to your plugin or server configuration.
zh: 在新的服务器设置上尝试该插件。这将消除由于插件或服务器配置而导致的大多数问题。

source: Do **NOT** just say "... doesn't work" because it's insufficient 90% of the time. Specify everything that you have tried to get it working, and provide relevant configs or logs.
zh: **不要**只是说“...不起作用”，因为此时90%还不够。指定你尝试使其正常工作的所有内容，并提供相关配置或日志。

source: Do not provide huge configuration files where 90% is unrelated to the issue you're dealing with. Find the **SIMPLEST** config setup which efficiently isolates the bugged feature
zh: 不要提供90%与你正在处理的问题无关的巨大配置文件。找到**最简单**的配置设置，它可以有效地隔离有缺陷的功能

source: Do NOT use screenshots to provide console logs
zh: 不要使用屏幕截图来提供控制台日志

source: | MMOItems | MMOCore | MMOProfiles | MMOInventory | MythicLib |
zh: |MMOItems|MMOCore|MMOProfiles|MMOInventory|MythicLib|

source: | [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoitems/-/issues) | [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmocore/-/issues) | [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoprofiles/-/issues) | [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoinventory/-/issues) | [Issue Tracker](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mythiclib/-/issues) |
zh: | [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoitems/-/issues)| [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmocore/-/issues)| [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoprofiles/-/issues)| [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoinventory/-/issues)| [问题跟踪器](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mythiclib/-/issues)|

source: Requesting a new feature
zh: 请求新功能

source: You should try and follow the previous guidelines as much as possible when asking for a new plugin feature. Admittedly most of the time a simple description will be sufficient if it is clear enough (like if you're asking for a new PAPI placeholder or anything pretty simple), yet for more complex features it is better to provide as much information as possible:
zh: 当请求新的插件功能时，你应该尝试并尽可能遵循之前的指南。诚然，大多数时候，如果足够清晰，简单的描述就足够了（例如，如果你要求新的 PAPI占位符或任何非常简单的东西），但对于更复杂的功能，最好提供尽可能多的信息：

source: quickly give some context
zh: 快速给出一些背景信息

source: highlight what the plugin is lacking (why something needs to be changed/added)
zh: 突出显示插件缺少什么（为什么需要更改/添加某些内容）

source: provide a solution (suggest as many ideas as possible and explain them precisely)
zh: 提供解决方案（提出尽可能多的想法并准确解释）

source: try and explain how useful it would be (this will make the devs more likely to implement it quickly)
zh: 尝试并解释它有多么有用（这将使开发人员更有可能快速实现它）

source: Similarly images, videos or simple schemes can help you explain what exactly you want added.
zh: 同样，图像、视频或简单的方案可以帮助你解释你到底想要添加什么。

source: Make sure your feature hasn't already been suggested using the search bar! This will also reduce dupe tickets.
zh: 确保尚未使用搜索栏建议你的功能！这也将减少欺骗票。

source: Generic
zh: 通用

source: Expression Check
zh: 表达检查

source: Use this condition to perform arithmetic and boolean calculations. You can use placeholders from PAPI returning `true` or `false` as well as logical operators (negation `!`, or `||`, and `&&`) and MythicLib will parse and compute the result of your boolean formula.
zh: 使用此条件执行算术和布尔计算。你可以使用 PAPI 中的占位符返回`true`或`false`以及逻辑运算符（否定`!`或`||`和`&&`），并且MythicLib将解析和计算布尔公式的结果。

source: This can be used to multiple compare numbers simultaneously, for instance using `(a < b) && (c >= d)`. The brackets are not mandatory but can help with readability. You can add as many spaces as you want between the different parts of the formula for better clarity.
zh: 这可用于同时比较多个数字，例如使用`(a < b) && (c >= d)`。括号不是强制性的，但有助于提高可读性。你可以在公式的不同部分之间添加任意多个空格，以提高清晰度。

source: | Parameter | Alias | Description | Default |
zh: |参数|别名 |描述 |默认 |

source: | formula | form, f, expression, expr, e | The boolean formula to evaluate. | - |
zh: |公式|形式、f、表达式、expr、e |要评估的布尔公式。 | - |

source: Has Variable
zh: 有变量

source: Checks if a variable exists. This can also be used against a reserved variable like `target` or `target_location`.
zh: 检查变量是否存在。这也可以用于保留变量，如`target`或`target_location`。

source: | variable | var, v, name, n | Name of the variable to check for. | - |
zh: |变量| var、v、名称、n |要检查的变量的名称。 | - |

source: String Contain
zh: 字符串包含

source: Use this condition to check if some string contains another string.
zh: 使用此条件检查某个字符串是否包含另一个字符串。

source: | within | in | The string to search in. | - |
zh: | within | in | 在此字符串中搜索。 | - |

source: | search | lookfor, look, lf | The string to search for. | - |
zh: |搜索 |寻找，看，lf |要搜索的字符串。 | - |

source: | ignore_case | ic | Whether to ignore case when comparing the strings. | false |
zh: |ignore_case|集成电路|比较字符串时是否忽略大小写。 |false|

source: This example script checks if the target entity is either a Zombie or a Skeleton.
zh: 此示例脚本检查目标实体是僵尸还是骷髅。

source: String Match
zh: 字符串匹配

source: Use this condition to check if two strings match exactly.
zh: 使用此条件检查两个字符串是否完全匹配。

source: | first | one, left, lhs | The first string. | - |
zh: |第一 |一，左，lhs |第一个字符串。 | - |

source: | second | two, right, rhs | The second string. | - |
zh: |第二 |两个，右，rhs |第二根弦。 | - |

source: This checks if the player is in a certain world:
zh: 这会检查玩家是否在某个世界中：

source: A script only executes its list of mechanics **when all of its conditions are met**. They are checked in-order, which means MythicLib will first evaluate the first condition, stop there if it's not met, then evaluate the second, stop if not met, etc... If all conditions are met, then mechanics are executed one after the other.
zh: 脚本仅在满足所有条件时才执行其机制列表。它们被检查in-order，这意味着MythicLib将首先评估第一个条件，如果不满足则停止，然后评估第二个条件，如果不满足则停止，依此类推......如果满足所有条件，则机制将依次执行。

source: | Condition Type | Description |
zh: |条件类型|描述 |

source: | [Generic](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/generic) | Math formulas, boolean expressions, string checks... |
zh: | [通用](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/generic)|数学公式、布尔表达式、字符串检查... |

source: | [Location](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/location) | Location-based conditions |
zh: | [位置](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/location)|Location-based条件 |

source: | [Miscellaneous](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/misc) | Other |
zh: | [杂项](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/misc)|其他|

source: Location
zh: 地点

source: Check for the target script location biome
zh: 检查目标脚本位置生物群系

source: Checks if the script target location (or source location when `source` is set to true) biome is a specific biome. List of biomes [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/block/Biome.html). You can use multiple biome names, separate them using `,`. Warning, biome names are highly case sensitive.
zh: 检查脚本目标位置（或当`source`设置为true时的源位置）生物群落是否是特定生物群落。生物群系列表[此处为](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/block/Biome.html)。你可以使用多个生物群系名称，并使用`,`将它们分开。警告，生物群落名称高度区分大小写。

source: Checking if some location is within block boundaries
zh: 检查某个位置是否在块边界内

source: Checks if the target location of the script (or source location, if `source` is set to true) is within a boundary that is defined by two other positions which are `loc1` and `loc2`. These positions must be provided using location targeters.
zh: 检查脚本的目标位置（或源位置，如果`source`设置为true）是否位于由其他两个位置`loc1`和`loc2`定义的边界内。这些位置必须使用位置目标选择器提供。

source: Check if script target location is close to another location
zh: 检查脚本目标位置是否靠近另一个位置

source: Checks if the script target location (or source location if `source` is set to true) is less than X blocks away from a center location.
zh: 检查脚本目标位置（或源位置，如果`source`设置为true）距中心位置是否小于 X 个街区。

source: Check for the script world
zh: 检查脚本世界

source: Checks if the script is ran in a specific world. You can use multiple world names, separate them using `,`. Warning, world names are highly case sensitive.
zh: 检查脚本是否在特定世界中运行。你可以使用多个世界名称，并使用`,`将它们分开。警告，世界名称高度区分大小写。

source: If script caster can damage/target entity
zh: 如果脚本施法者可以损坏/目标实体

source: This is a central check in MMO plugins. It is used to determine if the player can damage/buff another entity without this action being illegal. Imagine you don't want your player skills to damage players within the same party, this can be done using this condition. Similarly, you don't want players to be able to use heals or buffs onto enemies.
zh: 这是 MMO 插件的集中检查。它用于确定玩家是否可以损坏/增强另一个实体，而此操作不违法。想象一下，你不希望你的玩家技能损坏同一方内的玩家，可以使用此条件来完成。同样，你也不希望玩家能够对敌人使用治疗或增益效果。

source: The very same condition is checked by MMOCore/MMOItems skills to make sure they aren't cast onto the wrong target which would constitute a gameplay flaw.
zh: MMOCore/MMOItems技能检查相同的条件，以确保它们不会被投射到错误的目标上，从而构成游戏缺陷。

source: This checks many things:
zh: 这会检查很多事情：

source: if the target is a living entity (i.e if it has a health bar)
zh: 如果目标是生物体（如果有生命条则为i.e）

source: if the target is not an unkillable NPC from Citizens
zh: 如果目标不是Citizens中不可杀死的 NPC

source: if the player is not in the same party/guild as the script target
zh: 如果玩家与脚本目标不在同一队伍/行会中

source: WorldGuard/Residence/bukkit vanilla PvP flags.
zh: WorldGuard/住宅/bukkit原版PvP标志。

source: There are four different interaction types:
zh: 有四种不同的交互类型：

source: `OFFENSE_SKILL` (skills that do damage)
zh: `OFFENSE_SKILL`(技能造成伤害)

source: `OFFENSE_ACTION` (basic/melee/weapon attacks)
zh: `OFFENSE_ACTION`（基本/近战/武器攻击）

source: `SUPPORT_SKILL` (skills that buff or heal, apply a positive effect on target)
zh: `SUPPORT_SKILL`（技能增益或治疗，对目标施加积极效果）

source: `SUPPORT_ACTION` (not used yet) every time you use the `can_target` condition you need to specify the type of interaction so that MythicLib knows what to check in case you happen to use a supported party/guild plugin!
zh: `SUPPORT_ACTION`（尚未使用）每次使用`can_target`条件时，你需要指定交互类型，以便MythicLib知道要检查什么，以防你碰巧使用受支持的队伍/guild 插件！

source: The following skill, called `slash`, deals 100 damage to nearby entities **only if they can actually be damaged by the script runner**.
zh: 以下技能称为`slash`，对附近的实体造成100伤害**仅当它们实际上可以被脚本运行程序损坏**时。

source: Check for a player cooldown
zh: 检查玩家冷却时间

source: This checks if a player has something on cooldown. You have to select some string identifier, called cooldown paths, for MythicLib to save your cooldown information.
zh: 这会检查玩家上是否有冷却时间上的内容。你必须为MythicLib选择一些字符串标识符（称为冷却时间路径）来保存你的冷却时间信息。

source: If you'd like to check for cooldowns from MMOItems or MMOCore i.e item or skill cooldowns, please refer to [this wiki section](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables#cooldownmap) which provides which cooldown path you need to use for which object.
zh: 如果你想检查MMOItems或MMOCorei.e物品或技能冷却时间中的冷却时间，请参阅[此 wiki 部分](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables#cooldownmap)，其中提供了你需要的冷却时间路径用于哪个对象。

source: MythicLib fully lets you setup cooldowns. Paired with cooldown mechanics (learn more in the *Mechanics* wiki section) you can fully check, compute and apply cooldowns inside of your scripts.
zh: MythicLib完全允许你设置冷却时间。与冷却时间机制配合使用（在 *Mechanics* wiki 部分了解更多信息），你可以在脚本内全面检查、计算和应用冷却时间。

source: Check for the script caster's food level
zh: 检查脚本施法者的食物水平

source: Checks if the script caster has enough food. You could do the exact same condition using the `compare` generic condition but we're keeping this one for backwards compatibility.
zh: 检查脚本施法者是否有足够的食物。你可以使用`compare`通用条件执行完全相同的条件，但我们保留这一条件是为了向后兼容。

source: Check if attack which triggered the script has some damage type
zh: 检查触发脚本的攻击是否具有某种损坏类型

source: Please first learn about [triggers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers). When using the `ATTACK` trigger type, since the script was triggered by an attack you can actually access information about this attack using the `<attack>` internal variable.
zh: 请先了解一下【触发器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)。使用`ATTACK`触发器类型时，由于脚本是由攻击触发的，因此你实际上可以使用`<attack>`内部变量访问有关此攻击的信息。

source: This condition can be used to check if the attack which triggered the script contains some type of damage. This is very useful for player skills which should for instance only apply on weapon attacks: you just have to check if the attack contains some `WEAPON` damage.
zh: 此条件可用于检查触发脚本的攻击是否包含某种类型的损坏。这对于玩家技能非常有用，例如，它应该仅适用于武器攻击：你只需检查攻击是否包含一些`WEAPON`损坏。

source: You can use multiple damage types. If the attack contains ANY of the damage type provided the condition will be met. It will throw a console error if the script was not triggered by an entity attack.
zh: 你可以使用多种伤害类型。如果攻击包含任何损坏类型，则满足条件。如果脚本不是由实体攻击触发的，它将抛出控制台错误。

source: Check if the target entity is living
zh: 检查目标实体是否还活着

source: Checks if the target entity has a health bar.
zh: 检查目标实体是否有生命值条。

source: Check if the target entity is on fire
zh: 检查目标实体是否着火

source: Use this to check if the script target entity is on fire. This will check for the script caster if `caster` is set to true (false by default);
zh: 用它来检查脚本目标实体是否着火。这将检查脚本施法者是否将`caster`设置为true（默认情况下为false）；

source: Permission check
zh: 权限检查

source: Use this to check if the script caster has a specific permission.
zh: 使用它来检查脚本施法者是否具有特定的权限。

source: Time check
zh: 时间检查

source: Checks if the script world is within a certain time period: `DAY` (0 to 12000 ticks), `DUSK` (12000 to 13000), `NIGHT` (13000 to 23000) or `DAWN` (23000 to 24000). According to the wiki a Minecraft day lasts 20 minutes which is equivalent to 24k ticks.
zh: 检查脚本世界是否在特定时间段内：`DAY`（0到12000刻），`DUSK`（12000到13000），`NIGHT`（13000到23000） ）或`DAWN`（23000至24000）。根据 wiki，Minecraft一天持续20分钟，相当于24k刻。

source: This could be used for cool werewolf/dark mage passive skills which only trigger during the night!
zh: 这可以用于酷狼人/黑暗法师被动技能，它只在夜间触发！

source: 📜 Introduction
zh: 📜 简介

source: MythicLib provides a custom scripting language that allows you to perform actions, check conditions... to create custom behaviours for all MMO plugins. Scripts can be used to send messages, play particle effects, check for conditions, damage other entities, and many other things.
zh: MythicLib提供自定义脚本语言，允许你执行操作、检查条件...为所有 MMO 插件创建自定义行为。脚本可用于发送消息、播放粒子效果、检查条件、损坏其他实体以及许多其他事情。

source: Scripts perform specific actions which are called [mechanics](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro). You can also setup [conditions](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro) which have to be met for the script to run. Some mechanics require parameters like entities or positions: for instance if you'd like to spawn a particle at a given position, you need to specify that exact position, which is done using [targeters](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/intro). There are targeters for both entities and locations.
zh: 脚本执行称为[机制](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro)的特定操作。你还可以设置[脚本运行必须满足的条件](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro)。某些机制需要实体或位置等参数：例如，如果你想在给定位置生成粒子，则需要指定确切位置，这是使用 [目标选择器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/intro)完成的。实体和位置都有目标选择器。

source: MythicLib scripts also feature [variables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables) which you can use to save temporary information or do computations. For instance MythicLib has a wide variety of mechanics that you can use for vector calculation.
zh: MythicLib脚本还具有 [变量](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables)，你可以使用它来保存临时信息或进行计算。例如，MythicLib具有多种可用于矢量计算的机制。

source: MythicLib scripts can also be turned into MMOCore class skills or MMOItems item abilities, more information on this [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythiclib).
zh: MythicLib脚本也可以变成MMOCore职业技能或MMOItems物品能力，更多信息请参见此 [wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythiclib)。

source: Very Important!
zh: 非常重要！

source: > **Scripts are not skills!** You can turn scripts into skills, but not the other way around. MythicLib scripts are a way to implement skills which will then be used in MMOCore or MMOItems. Fabled and MythicMobs also provide their script/skill systems. Overall, the MythicLib scripting language is less capable but great for handling basic tasks and not-too-complex skills. You don't need to install anything else to use MythicLib scripts, they are built-in and ready to use.
zh: > **脚本不是技能！** 你可以将脚本转换为技能，但反之则不行。MythicLib脚本是实现技能的一种方法，然后将在MMOCore或MMOItems中使用。Fabled和MythicMobs还提供其脚本/技能系统。总体而言，MythicLib脚本语言的能力较差，但非常适合处理基本任务和not-too-complex技能。你无需安装任何其他内容即可使用MythicLib脚本，它们是built-in并且可以使用。

source: The primary goal of the MythicLib custom skill system is the ability to register skills with the plugin which you like to program the most with. If MMOItems or MMOCore asks you to use ML scripts you can always use MythicMobs or Fabled instead to have custom scripts executed.
zh: MythicLib定制技能系统的主要目标是能够使用你最喜欢用来编程的插件注册技能。如果MMOItems或MMOCore要求你使用 ML 脚本，你始终可以使用MythicMobs或Fabled来执行自定义脚本。

source: Since scripts are used in MMOCore and MMOItems, they are heavily oriented towards creating custom abilities, skills or attack effects. Therefore, they feature premade tools like shaped mechanics which let you easily display cool particle effects, raycasts, projectiles etc.
zh: 由于脚本用于MMOCore和MMOItems，因此它们主要面向创建自定义能力、技能或攻击效果。因此，它们具有预制工具，例如形状力学，可让你轻松显示炫酷的粒子效果、光线投射、投射物等。

source: Script Example
zh: 脚本示例

source: When a player runs the `teststaff` script it will send out a ray of redstone particles to the first entity in the caster's line of sight and then at said entity and deals 10 damage.
zh: 当玩家运行`teststaff`脚本时，它会向施法者视线中的第一个实体发送一束红石粒子，然后向该实体发送一束红石粒子，并造成10伤害。

source: You can then reload your ML scripts using `/ml reload` and cast your new skill using `/ml cast YOUR_SCRIPT_NAME_HERE`
zh: 然后，你可以使用`/ml reload`重新加载 ML 脚本，并使用`/ml cast YOUR_SCRIPT_NAME_HERE`投射新的技能

source: Numeric Parameters
zh: 数值参数

source: Many mechanics include "numeric parameters": the amount of damage dealt by the `damage` mechanic, the duration in ticks of a potion effect being applied, the radius of a particle sphere...
zh: 许多机制都包含“数字参数”：`damage`机制造成的伤害量、应用药水效果的持续时间（以刻为单位）、粒子球体的半径……

source: 99% of these mechanics fully support mathematical formulas. This means that you can use numbers in conjunction with commonly used operators, math functions, and even PAPI placeholders to unlock full configurability with your custom skills. Numerical formulas also support [internal variables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables) as described below.
zh: 99%这些力学完全支持数学公式。这意味着你可以将数字与常用运算符、数学函数甚至 PAPI占位符结合使用，以解锁自定义技能的完整可配置性。数值公式还支持[内部变量](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables)，如下所述。

source: Text Parameters
zh: 文本参数

source: Mechanics which require strings support placeholders from PlaceholderAPI, although these are not the only placeholders you can use. MythicLib also has [internal variables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables) that you can access using `<...>` instead of the usual `%...%` format from PlaceholderAPI.
zh: 需要字符串的机制支持PlaceholderAPI中的占位符，尽管这些并不是你可以使用的唯一占位符。MythicLib还具有[内部变量](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables)，你可以使用`<...>`访问它们，而不是PlaceholderAPI中通常的`%...%`格式。

source: JSON/YAML Syntaxes
zh: JSON/YAML语法

source: The two following formats for a skill are totally equivalent and both will work just fine, so you might just use the one you like the best. If you are more familiar with MythicMobs, use the second one. If you are more familiar with pure YAML or even Fabled, use the first one. The second JSON-ish format is only available starting with MythicLib 1.6.2+ development builds.
zh: 技能的以下两种格式完全等效，并且都可以正常工作，因此你可以使用你最喜欢的一种。如果你更熟悉MythicMobs，请使用第二个。如果你更熟悉纯YAML甚至Fabled，请使用第一个。第二种JSON-ish 格式仅从MythicLib1.6.2+ 开发版本开始可用。

source: The second format uses a string list to store the script mechanics and conditions instead of configuration sections. This format is more compact but readability can be a little harder.
zh: 第二种格式使用字符串列表来存储脚本机制和条件，而不是配置部分。这种格式更紧凑，但可读性可能有点困难。

source: 💖 Buffs & Stats
zh: 💖 增益 &属性

source: Add Temporary Stats
zh: 添加临时属性

source: This adds a stat to the player. You can use all the stats within MMOCore and MMOItems. It will be removed when the server restarts.
zh: 这将属性添加到玩家。你可以使用MMOCore和MMOItems中的所有属性。当服务器重新启动时它将被删除。

source: For temporary stat buffs/debuffs, you can add a duration using the `lifetime` parameter (in ticks). Set `relative` to `true` and the buff will grant 10% Atk Damage instead of a flat +10 Atk Damage.
zh: 对于临时属性增益/减益，你可以使用`lifetime`参数添加持续时间（以刻为单位）。将`relative`设置为`true`，该增益将授予10%攻击力伤害，而不是平的 +10攻击力伤害。

source: The `key` parameter is optional. It's the key you need to provide to remove your modifier later on if you need. There can be multiple stats using the same key, and using the `remove_stat` mechanic with that key will remove all of them.
zh: `key`参数是可选的。这是你需要提供的密钥，以便稍后在需要时删除修饰符。可以有多个属性使用同一把钥匙，并且使用带有该钥匙的`remove_stat`机械师将删除所有这些。

source: Set `unique` to `true` if you want only one modifier with the same key to be active at a time. **If a new modifier is added with the same key, it will replace the previous one.** This is useful for buffs that you want to refresh periodically.
zh: 如果你希望一次仅激活一个具有相同键的修改器，请将`unique`设置为`true`。 **如果使用相同的键添加新的修改器，它将取代之前的修改器。** 这对于你想要定期刷新的增益效果非常有用。

source: Remove Temporary Stats
zh: 删除临时属性

source: The following mechanic removes all stat modifiers with the associated `key`. It does not matter if the stat modifiers are temporary or permanent.
zh: 以下机制删除所有属性修正器及其关联的`key`。属性修正器是临时的还是永久的并不重要。

source: Heal target
zh: 治疗目标

source: `reason` (why the target is being healed) is optional (`CUSTOM` by default). It's better to indicate it so that other plugins know the healing source. Available sources [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/event/entity/EntityRegainHealthEvent.RegainReason.html).
zh: `reason`（目标被治疗的原因）是可选的（默认为`CUSTOM`）。最好指出它，以便其他插件知道治疗来源。可用来源[此处](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/event/entity/EntityRegainHealthEvent.RegainReason.html)。

source: Give food to target
zh: 给目标食物

source: Highest food level is 20. A player's food level is always an integer (unlike health). This mechanic **SETS** the player's food level.
zh: 最高食物等级是20。玩家的食物等级始终是整数（与生命值不同）。该机械师 **SETS**玩家的食物等级。

source: Restore saturation of target
zh: 恢复目标饱和度

source: This mechanic **SETS** the target's saturation level.
zh: 该机制**设置**目标的饱和度。

source: 👾 External
zh: 👾 外部

source: 🔧 Mechanics
zh: 🔧 力学

source: A script is a list of mechanics and conditions. If all of the script conditions are met, then its mechanics are ran in order, from first to last. A mechanic is a specific action, it can be sending a projectile, sending a message to a player, playing a sound to multiple entities, etc.
zh: 脚本是机制和条件的列表。如果满足所有脚本条件，则其机制将按从第一个到最后一个的顺序运行。机制是一个特定的动作，它可以发送投射物、向玩家发送消息、向多个实体播放声音等。

source: | Mechanic Type | Description |
zh: |机械类型|描述 |

source: | [Buffs](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/buffs) | Give temporary stats; restore health, food... |
zh: | [增益效果](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/buffs)|给予临时属性；恢复生命值，食物... |

source: | [Projectiles](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/projectiles) | Throw physical projectiles |
zh: | [投射物](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/projectiles)|投掷物理投射物|

source: | [Miscellaneous](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/misc) | Commands, cooldowns, delay, entity effects... |
zh: | [杂项](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/misc)|命令、冷却时间、延迟、实体效果... |

source: | [Movement](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/movement) | Give velocity and teleport |
zh: | [机芯](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/movement)|给出速度和传送|

source: | [Offense](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/offense) | Deal damage, apply potion effects... |
zh: | [进攻](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/offense)|造成伤害，施加药水效果... |

source: | [Shapes](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/shapes) | Helixes, slashes, parabolas... |
zh: | [形状](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/shapes)|螺旋线、斜线、抛物线... |

source: | [Variables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/variables) | Edit/create numbers, vectors etc. |
zh: | [变量](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/variables)|编辑/创建数字、矢量等 |

source: | [Visual](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/visual) | Messages, sounds and particles |
zh: | [视觉](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/visual)|消息、声音和粒子|

source: | [Inventory/UI](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/inventory) | Inventory/GUI related mechanics |
zh: | [物品栏/UI](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/inventory)|物品栏/GUI相关机械 |

source: | [External](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/external) | Mechanics implemented by other plugins |
zh: | [外部](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/external)|其他插件实现的机制 |

source: 🎒 Inventory
zh: 🎒物品栏

source: Use this mechanic to close the current player's inventory. This can be used inside any MMO plugin UI: MMOItems crafting stations, MMOProfiles profile selection, MMOCore skill tree UIs, etc...
zh: 使用此机制可以关闭当前玩家的物品栏。这可以在任何 MMO 插件 UI 中使用：MMOItems合成站、MMOProfiles档案选择、MMOCore技能树UI 等...

source: Go Back
zh: 返回

source: Use this to have the player navigate to the last page visited. For instance, this can be used to go back from the *Class Confirmation UI* to the *Class Selection UI* in MMOCore for instance.
zh: 使用此功能可以让玩家导航到上次访问的页面。例如，这可用于从 *职业确认 UI* 返回到MMOCore中的 *职业选择 UI*。

source: Apply cooldown
zh: 适用冷却时间

source: In MMOItems/MMOCore, any object that has a cooldown (an item, parrying, dodging, a skill etc.) has a cooldown key associated with it (see [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables#cooldownmap)). As long as it's not being used in MMOItems/MMOCore, you can claim any string key for your plugin and use it for anything.
zh: 在MMOItems/MMOCore中，任何具有冷却时间的对象（物品、招架、闪避、技能等）都有一个与其关联的冷却时间密钥（请参阅[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables#cooldownmap)）。只要它没有在MMOItems/MMOCore中使用，你就可以为你的插件声明任何字符串密钥并将其用于任何用途。

source: MythicLib fully lets you setup cooldowns. Paired with cooldown conditions you can fully check, compute and apply cooldowns inside of your scripts.
zh: MythicLib完全允许你设置冷却时间。与冷却时间条件配合使用，你可以在脚本内全面检查、计算和应用冷却时间。

source: Cooldown value is in seconds.
zh: 冷却时间值以秒为单位。

source: Reduce cooldown of target
zh: 减少目标的冷却时间

source: > First learn above the mechanic above.
zh: > 首先学习上面的机制。

source: `value` determines the amount of cooldown reduction, by default in seconds. Parameter `reduction` determines the "reduction mode" as explained below.
zh: `value`确定冷却时间减少的量，默认以秒为单位。参数`reduction`确定“缩减模式”，如下所述。

source: If the mode is set to `FLAT`, target cooldown will be reduced by a set amount of seconds. If the mode is set to `INITIAL`, target cooldown will be reduced by X% of its initial value. For an initial cooldown of 10s, a 20% cooldown reduction with mode `INITIAL` will reduce the target cooldown by `20% * 10 = 2s`.
zh: 如果模式设置为`FLAT`，目标冷却时间将减少设定的秒数。如果模式设置为`INITIAL`，目标冷却时间将减少其初始值的 X%。对于10s的初始冷却时间，使用模式`INITIAL`进行20%冷却时间缩减将把目标冷却时间缩减`20% * 10 = 2s`。

source: If the mode is set to `REMAINING`, target cooldown will be reduced by X% of its remaining (not total) value. For a 10s cooldown, if 3s have passed, remaining cooldown is 7s. A 20% remaining cooldown reduction is equivalent to a flat `20% * (10 - 3) = 1.4s` cooldown reduction.
zh: 如果模式设置为`REMAINING`，目标冷却时间将减少其剩余（不是总计）值的 X%。对于10s冷却时间，如果3s已通过，则剩余的冷却时间为7s。20%剩余的冷却时间减少相当于`20% * (10 - 3) = 1.4s`冷却时间的固定减少。

source: Adding delay to your script
zh: 为脚本添加延迟

source: Delay is in **ticks**. ML will wait a certain number of ticks before executing the next mechanic. Make sure the delay parameter is above zero.
zh: 延迟以**刻**为单位。机器学习将在执行下一个机制之前等待一定数量的时钟周期。确保延迟参数大于零。

source: Dispatch a command
zh: 发送命令

source: Set `from_console` to `true` to have the command dispatched by console instead, otherwise ML takes the script target entity. Set `op` to true to have the command ran as op. `target` is optional.
zh: 将`from_console`设置为`true`以使命令改为由控制台调度，否则 ML 将采用脚本目标实体。将`op`设置为true以使命令作为 op 运行。`target`是可选的。

source: Play an entity effect
zh: 播放实体效果

source: Entity effects available [on the Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/EntityEffect.html). For instance, `HURT` is very useful, it just simulates a 0-damage attack - perfect for improving skills with non-damaging effects -. `target` is the entity on which the effect will be played. If not provided, it defaults to the script target entity, or script caster.
zh: 实体效果可用[在Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/EntityEffect.html)上。例如，`HURT`非常有用，它只是模拟0损坏攻击 - 非常适合通过non-damaging效果改进技能-。`target`是将播放效果的实体。如果未提供，则默认为脚本目标实体或脚本施法者。

source: Trigger a lightning strike
zh: 引发雷击

source: Setting `effect` to `false` makes the lightning deal no damage.
zh: 将`effect`设置为`false`使闪电不会造成伤害。

source: Cast another script
zh: 投射另一个剧本

source: This mechanic is pretty special. It can be used to cast another script with specific target entities and locations. It can also be used to modify the source location of a script.
zh: 这个机械师非常特别。它可用于投射具有特定目标实体和位置的另一个脚本。它还可用于修改脚本的源位置。

source: All of its parameters are optional. You can provide an entity targeter (for the script target entity, through `target`) and two location targeters (one for the script source location through `source`, and one for the script target location through `target_location`).
zh: 它的所有参数都是可选的。你可以提供一个实体目标选择器（对于脚本目标实体，通过`target`）和两个位置目标选择器（一个通过`source`用于脚本源位置，一个通过`target_location`用于脚本目标位置）。

source: This can also be used to cast the same script multiple times in a row, while counting the amount of times it has been cast so far. The following script casts 12 times the script called `ite`. The variable `iteration_count` is used to count the amount of times the script has been cast so far. It can therefore be accessed using the placeholder `<iteration_count>`.
zh: 这也可用于连续多次投射同一脚本，同时计算迄今为止已投射的次数。以下脚本将12乘以名为`ite`的脚本。变量`iteration_count`用于计算到目前为止脚本已被投射的次数。因此可以使用占位符`<iteration_count>`对其进行访问。

source: Give an item
zh: 给一个物品

source: Give a vanilla item to a player.
zh: 将原版物品赋予玩家。

source: Shoot an arrow
zh: 射箭

source: Have the player shoot an arrow. `from_item` is used by MMOItems for weapon types. `player_attack_damage` makes the arrow use the player's attack damage attribute as base damage. `velocity` is a multiplier for the arrow's speed. Default is 1.0 (normal speed).
zh: 让玩家射箭。`from_item`由MMOItems用于武器类型。`player_attack_damage`使箭头使用玩家的攻击伤害基础属性作为基础伤害。`velocity`是箭头速度的乘数。默认为1.0（正常速度）。

source: `damage_types` is a comma-separated list of damage types to apply to the arrow. By default, arrows deal physical/weapon damage unless modified in the MythicLib config file.
zh: `damage_types`是应用于箭头的伤害类型comma-separated列表。默认情况下，除非在MythicLib配置文件中进行修改，否则箭头会造成物理/武器伤害。

source: `hit` is the name of a script to be executed when the arrow hits an entity or block. `land` is the name of a script to be executed when the arrow lands on the ground without hitting anything. `tick` is the name of a script to be executed every tick while the arrow is flying.
zh: `hit`是当箭头击中实体或块时要执行的脚本的名称。`land`是当箭头落在地面上但没有击中任何物体时要执行的脚本的名称。`tick`是箭头飞行时每个刻执行的脚本的名称。

source: Cancel event
zh: 取消活动

source: If the script was triggered by an event (like EntityDamageByEntityEvent, PlayerInteractEvent, etc.), this mechanic will cancel that event. Otherwise, it will print out an error.
zh: 如果脚本是由事件（如 EntityDamageByEntityEvent、PlayerInteractEvent 等）触发的，则此机制将取消该事件。否则，会打印出错误。

source: This can be used to prevent damage during an entity damage event, for instance.
zh: 例如，这可以用于防止实体损坏事件期间的损坏。

source: 🚶 Movement
zh: 🚶 运动

source: Teleport an entity
zh: 传送一个实体

source: This will teleport the target entity to target location.
zh: 这会将目标实体传送到目标位置。

source: | target_location | - | Location targeter required. Where to teleport. | target location |
zh: |target_location| - |需要位置目标选择器。传送到哪里。 |目标位置|

source: | target | - | Entity targeter required. Entity to teleport. | caster |
zh: |目标| - |需要实体目标选择器。要传送的实体。 |脚轮 |

source: | y_offset | - | Y offset applied to the target location. | 0 |
zh: |y_offset| - |应用于目标位置的 Y 偏移。 |0|

source: Set the velocity of an entity
zh: 设置实体的速度

source: You need to use a variable in order to provide a position (<=> vector). In the following example, the vector is saved in the variable called `velocity1`.
zh: 你需要使用变量来提供位置（<=>向量）。在以下示例中，向量保存在名为`velocity1`的变量中。

source: | target | - | Entity targeter required. Entity to set the velocity of. | caster |
zh: |目标| - |需要实体目标选择器。要设置速度的实体。 |脚轮 |

source: | value | val, v, vector, vec, velocity, vel | Name of variable containing the vector (position) to set the velocity to. | none |
zh: |价值| val、v、矢量、vec、速度、vel |包含要设置速度的矢量（位置）的变量名称。 |无 |

source: ⚔️ Offense
zh: ⚔️进攻

source: Deal damage to an entity
zh: 对实体造成伤害

source: Deals damage to the entity provided. This applies on-hit effects, crit strikes, damage mitigation... (fully compatible with MMOItems and MMOCore).
zh: 对所提供的实体造成伤害。这适用于on-hit效果、暴击、伤害减免...（与MMOItems和MMOCore完全兼容）。

source: | amount | amt, a, damage, dmg, d, value, val, v | The amount of damage to deal. | - |
zh: |金额 | amt、a、伤害、dmg、d、值、val、v |造成的伤害量。 | - |

source: | knockback | kb, knock | If true, applies knockback to the target. | true |
zh: |击退| kb，敲|如果true，则将击退应用于目标。 |true|

source: | ignore_immunity | ii | If true, ignores the target's invulnerability frames. | false |
zh: |ignore_immunity| ii |如果是true，则忽略目标的无敌帧。 |false|

source: | damage_type | dtype, dt | The damage type(s) to deal. Separate damage types with commas and no spaces. See available damage types [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage). | magic,skill |
zh: |damage_type| dtype，dt |要造成的伤害类型。用逗号分隔损坏类型且不包含空格。查看可用的损坏类型[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage)。 |魔法，技能|

source: | element | - | The element name to deal damage with. See available elements [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/elements) | none |
zh: |元素| - |处理伤害的元素名称。查看可用元素[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/elements)|无 |

source: | target | - | The target entity or entities to deal damage to. | target or caster |
zh: |目标| - |要造成伤害的一个或多个目标实体。 |目标或施法者|

source: Multiply the current attack damage
zh: 乘以当前的攻击伤害

source: Multiplies the current attack damage by a given amount.
zh: 将当前攻击伤害乘以给定量。

source: | value | val, v, amount, amt, a, scalar, s, coef, c | The amount to multiply the damage by. Can be an expression. | - |
zh: |价值| val、v、金额、amt、a、标量、s、coef、c |伤害乘以的金额。可以是一个表达式。 | - |

source: | damage_type | dtype, dt | The damage type to modify. See available damage types [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage) | none |
zh: |damage_type| dtype，dt |要修改的损坏类型。查看可用的损坏类型[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage)|无 |

source: | additive | - | If true, this damage buff will stack additively with other additive buffs. | false |
zh: |添加剂| - |如果true，该伤害增益将与其他增益增益叠加。 |false|

source: | element | - | The element name to modify. See available elements [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/elements) | none |
zh: |元素| - |要修改的元素名称。查看可用元素[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/elements)|无 |

source: If no damage type is provided the entire attack damage is modified. Otherwise only the specific portion of the attack due to the given damage type is affected. If an element name is provided, only damage due to that specific element will be affected.
zh: 如果未提供损坏类型，则修改整个攻击伤害。否则，只有给定伤害类型造成的攻击的特定部分受到影响。如果提供了元素名称，则只有该特定元素造成的损害才会受到影响。

source: You cannot provide both an element and a damage type. When providing an element name, the damage type parameter is ignored.
zh: 你不能同时提供元素和损坏类型。提供元素名称时，损坏类型参数将被忽略。

source: If `additive` is set to `true`, this damage buff will stack with stats like PvE damage, Undead Damage (which stacks additively i.e `10% + 10% <=> +20%`). Otherwise, buffs stack up geometrically i.e `110% * 110% = 121% <=> +21%`.
zh: 如果`additive`设置为`true`，则该伤害增益将与属性叠加，如PvE伤害、不死伤害（叠加i.e`10% + 10% <=> +20%`）。否则，增益会以几何方式叠加i.e`110% * 110% = 121% <=> +21%`。

source: Apply potion effect
zh: 应用药水效果

source: Gives a potion effect to the target entity, for a given duration, with given level. Potion effect names are available on the [Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html).
zh: 在给定的持续时间和给定的等级下，为目标实体提供药水效果。药水效果名称可在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html)上找到。

source: | effect | eff, e, pe | Name of potion effect to take off | - |
zh: |效果| eff、e、pe |起效药水名称| - |

source: | duration | dur, d, ticks, t, time | Duration of potion effect in ticks | - |
zh: | duration | dur, d, ticks, t, time | 药水效果的持续时间，单位为刻（tick）。 | - |

source: | level | lvl, l | Level of potion effect (0 = level 1, 1 = level 2, etc.) | 0 |
zh: |等级 |等级，l |药水效果等级（0= 等级1、1= 等级2等） |0|

source: | ambient | amb | If true, the potion effect will be ambient. | false |
zh: |环境 |琥珀 |如果true，药水效果将为环境效果。 |false|

source: | particles | part | If false, the potion effect will have no particles. | true |
zh: |颗粒|部分|如果为false，药水效果将没有粒子。 |true|

source: | icon | ic | If false, the potion effect will have no icon. | true |
zh: |图标|集成电路|如果是false，药水效果将没有图标。 |true|

source: | target | - | The target entity to set on fire. | target or caster |
zh: |目标| - |要着火的目标实体。 |目标或施法者 |

source: Remove potion effect
zh: 去除药水效果

source: Takes off a potion effect from the target entity. Potion effect names are available on the [Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html).
zh: 取消目标实体的药水效果。药水效果名称可在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html)上找到。

source: Set on fire
zh: 放火烧

source: Sets the target entity on fire for a certain amount of time (in ticks).
zh: 让目标实体着火一段时间（以刻为单位）。

source: | ticks | t, duration, dur, d, time | Amount of time to set the entity on fire for, in ticks. | - |
zh: |刻| t、持续时间、dur、d、时间 |使实体着火的时间量（以刻为单位）。 | - |

source: | stack | add | If true, adds the provided ticks to the entity's current fire ticks instead of setting it. | false |
zh: |堆栈|添加|如果是true，则将提供的刻添加到实体的当前火刻中，而不是设置它。 |false|

source: | max | - | If true, takes to the maximum between the current fire ticks and the provided ticks. | false |
zh: |最大| - |如果true，则取当前触发刻和提供的刻之间的最大值。 |false|

source: | min | - | If true, takes the minimum between the current fire ticks and the provided ticks. | false |
zh: |分钟 | - |如果true，则取当前触发刻和提供的刻之间的最小值。 |false|

source: `stack` has precedence over `max` and `min`, and `max` has precedence over `min`.
zh: `stack`优先于`max`和`min`，`max`优先于`min`。

source: Set no damage ticks
zh: 设置无伤害刻

source: | ticks | t, duration, dur, d, time | Duration of invulnerability in ticks | 10 |
zh: |刻| t、持续时间、dur、d、时间 |刻的无敌持续时间|10|

source: | stack | add | If true, adds the provided ticks to the entity's no damage ticks instead of setting it. | false |
zh: |堆栈|添加|如果是true，则将提供的刻添加到实体的无损坏刻中，而不是设置它。 |false|

source: | max | - | If true, takes the maximum between the current no damage ticks and the provided ticks. | false |
zh: |最大| - |如果true，则取当前无损坏刻和提供的刻之间的最大值。 |false|

source: | min | - | If true, takes the minimum between the current no damage ticks and the provided ticks. | false |
zh: |分钟| - |如果true，则取当前无损坏刻和提供的刻之间的最小值。 |false|

source: | target | - | The target entity | target or caster |
zh: |目标| - |目标实体 |目标或施法者 |

source: Makes the target entity invulnerable for the provided amount of time (in ticks).
zh: 使目标实体在指定的时间内（以刻为单位）无敌。

source: 🏹 Projectiles
zh: 🏹 射弹

source: Shoot Arrow
zh: 射箭

source: Use this mechanic to have the skill caster fire an arrow.
zh: 使用此机制让技能施法者发射箭。

source: | from_item | - | When true, MMOItems will take into account the bow stats for crits, attack damage... | false |
zh: |from_item| - |当true、MMOItems会考虑弓属性的暴击，攻击伤害... |false|

source: | player_attack_damage | - | Whether to use the player's attack damage attribute as base damage for the arrow. | false |
zh: |player_attack_damage| - |是否使用玩家的攻击伤害基础属性作为箭头的基础伤害。 |false|

source: | velocity | vel, speed, sp | Multiplier for the arrow's speed. | 1.0 |
zh: |速度| vel、速度、sp |箭头速度的乘数。 |1.0|

source: | hit | - | Script called when the arrow hits an entity or block. | - |
zh: |击中| - |当箭头击中实体或块时调用脚本。 | - |

source: | land | - | Script called when the arrow lands on the ground without hitting anything. | - |
zh: |土地| - |当箭落在地面上但没有击中任何物体时调用脚本。 | - |

source: | tick | - | Script called every tick while the arrow is flying. | - |
zh: |勾选 | - |脚本在箭头飞行时调用每个刻。 | - |

source: | damage_types | - | Comma-separated list of damage types to apply to the arrow. | `*` |
zh: |damage_types| - |Comma-separated适用于箭头的伤害类型列表。 |`*`|

source: `*` The default damage types are the ones provided in the MythicLib config file for bow attacks.
zh: `*`默认伤害类型是MythicLib配置文件中为弓箭攻击提供的伤害类型。

source: The following script is used by MMOItems to handle attacks from the *Crossbow* weapon type. It makes sure that arrows are only consumed when not in creative mode or when the arrow has the `MMOITEMS_DISABLE_ARROW_CONSUMPTION` tag. It also makes the arrow shoot faster based on the player's `arrow_velocity` stat, and adds a particle effect to the flying arrow.
zh: MMOItems使用以下脚本来处理来自 *Crossbow*武器类型的攻击。它确保仅在不处于创造模式或箭头具有`MMOITEMS_DISABLE_ARROW_CONSUMPTION`标签时才消耗箭头。它还在玩家的`arrow_velocity`属性的基础上使箭射得更快，并为飞行的箭添加了粒子效果。

source: Shulker Bullet
zh: 潜影贝导弹

source: Use this mechanic to have the skill caster fire a shulker bullet.
zh: 使用此机制让技能施法者发射潜影贝导弹。

source: | life_span | lifetime, l, ticks, duration, dur, d | The lifespan of the shulker bullet in ticks. | 60 |
zh: |life_span|生命周期、l、刻、持续时间、dur、d |潜影贝导弹的寿命（以刻为单位）。 |60|

source: | hit_entity | - | Script called when the shulker bullet hits an entity. | - |
zh: |hit_entity| - |当潜影贝导弹击中实体时调用的脚本。 | - |

source: 📐 Shapes
zh: 📐 形状

source: To get used to these mechanics, which can get really complex, but are really fun to configure, use a simple tick script to see what shape the mechanic draws!
zh: 要习惯这些可能非常复杂但配置起来非常有趣的机制，请使用简单的刻脚本来查看机制绘制的形状！

source: Helix
zh: 螺旋

source: The script indicated by the `end` config option is called when the helix is fully drawn.
zh: 当螺旋线完全绘制时，将调用`end`配置选项指示的脚本。

source: Parabola
zh: 抛物线

source: A parabola displayed between two locations. You can configure the height of the parabola and the speed at which it is displayed.
zh: 两个位置之间显示的抛物线。你可以配置抛物线的高度及其显示速度。

source: Projectile
zh: 投射物

source: A projectile that stops onto the first hit block/entity. You have to specify the type of interaction that your projectile corresponds to (offensive skill, support skill etc. - learn more about it [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/misc#if-script-caster-can-damagetarget-entity)).
zh: 射弹停在第一个击中的方块/实体上。你必须指定你的射弹对应的交互类型（进攻性技能、支持技能等 - 了解更多信息 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/misc#if-script-caster-can-damagetarget-entity)）。

source: Raycast
zh: 光线投射

source: Raycasts are invisible rays that are shot from the player's eye location. They stop on first block or entity hit.
zh: 光线投射是从玩家的眼睛位置发射的不可见光线。他们在第一个方块或实体命中时停止。

source: | range | rng, length, len, distance, dist | Length of the raycast | 50 |
zh: |范围 | rng、长度、len、距离、dist |光线投射的长度 |50|

source: | size | width, wide | Width of the raycast | 0.2 |
zh: |尺寸|宽度，宽|光线投射的宽度 |0.2|

source: | step_size | step, st, ss | Distance between two calls of the tick script | 0.4 |
zh: |step_size|步，ST，SS |两次调用刻脚本之间的距离 |0.4|

source: | ignore_passable | ip | Whether passable blocks should be ignored | false |
zh: |ignore_passable| ip |是否应忽略可通过的块 |false|

source: | neutral | - | Whether the raycast is neutral (does not check for friendly fire) | false |
zh: |中立 | - |光线投射是否为中性（不检查友军火力）|false|

source: | offense | - | Whether the raycast is offensive (checks for friendly fire) | true |
zh: |进攻| - |光线投射是否具有攻击性（检查友军火力）|true|

source: | tick | - | Script called every step of the raycast | none |
zh: |勾选 | - |脚本调用光线投射的每一步 |无 |

source: | hit_entity | - | Script called when hitting an entity | none |
zh: |hit_entity| - |击中实体时调用的脚本 |无 |

source: | hit_block | - | Script called when hitting a block | none |
zh: |hit_block| - |击中方块时调用的脚本 |无 |

source: Slash
zh: 斜线

source: Performs what looks like a weapon slash in front of the script caster
zh: 在脚本施法者面前执行类似武器的斜线操作

source: Sphere
zh: 球体

source: 🧮 Variables
zh: 🧮 变量

source: **Please first learn about variables** [**here**](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables). Since variables have scopes, every time you are editing or initializing a variable, you must provide the variable scope using the `scope` option. By default it's always set to `SKILL`.
zh: **请先了解变量** [**此处**](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/variables)。由于变量具有作用域，因此每次编辑或初始化变量时，都必须使用`scope`选项提供变量作用域。默认情况下，它始终设置为`SKILL`。

source: Other variables
zh: 其他变量

source: There is always one mechanic for both initializing and editing the current value of a variable.
zh: 始终有一种机制可用于初始化和编辑变量的当前值。

source: Initialize/edit a number with decimals (a double)
zh: 初始化/编辑带小数的数字（双精度）

source: Initialize/edit an integer
zh: 初始化/编辑整数

source: The formula provided in the `value` option can return a double, though since it is an integer variable, ML will round the returned number to the closest lower integer.
zh: `value`选项中提供的公式可以返回双精度值，但由于它是整数变量，ML 会将返回的数字四舍五入为最接近的较低整数。

source: Initialize/edit a string variable
zh: 初始化/编辑字符串变量

source: This saves the script caster world name in a variable.
zh: 这会将脚本施法者的世界名称保存在变量中。

source: Initialize/edit a vector
zh: 初始化/编辑向量

source: Vector calculation mechanics
zh: 矢量计算机制

source: Locations, positions, vectors are treated the same way in MythicLib. The following mechanics have been implemented to make script creation a little easier: ML provides a small bundle of basic/more complex mechanics for vector calculation.
zh: 在MythicLib中，位置、位置、向量的处理方式相同。为了使脚本创建更加容易，已经实现了以下机制： ML 提供了一小部分用于矢量计算的基本/更复杂的机制。

source: Vector addition
zh: 向量加法

source: Use this to add a vector (stored in a variable) to another vector (stored in another variable).
zh: 使用它将一个向量（存储在变量中）添加到另一个向量（存储在另一个变量中）。

source: You can also use this to add x,y,z coordinates separately to the existing vector variable:
zh: 你还可以使用它将 x、y、z 坐标分别添加到现有向量变量：

source: Copy/duplicate vector
zh: 复制/重复向量

source: Copies an existing vector (with name given by the `copied` option) into another variable (with name given by the `variable` option). The `scope` option corresponds to the scope of the new variable created.
zh: 将现有向量（名称由`copied`选项指定）复制到另一个变量（名称由`variable`选项指定）。`scope`选项对应于创建的新变量的范围。

source: Vector dot product
zh: 向量点积

source: Computes the dot product of vectors `vec1` and `vec2` and saves it in a variable. The result is a decimal number (double).
zh: 计算向量`vec1`和`vec2`的点积并将其保存在变量中。结果是一个十进制数（双精度）。

source: This is completely equivalent:
zh: 这是完全等价的：

source: Multiply vector by a constant
zh: 将向量乘以常数

source: Multiplies the X, Y and Z coordinates of a vector by the same constant.
zh: 将向量的 X、Y 和 Z 坐标乘以相同的常数。

source: Normalize a vector
zh: 标准化向量

source: This takes a vector and makes it of length 1 (essentially divide it by its own length) which is useful when working with vectors describing directions.
zh: 这需要一个向量并使其长度为1（本质上是除以它自己的长度），这在处理描述方向的向量时很有用。

source: Set X/Y/Z coordinate of a vector
zh: 设置向量的 X/Y/Z 坐标

source: The mechanic names are `set_x`, `set_y` and `set_z`. The following mechanic sets the Y coordinate of vector in variable `knockback` to 0.
zh: 机械师名称为`set_x`、`set_y`和`set_z`。以下机制将变量`knockback`中向量的 Y 坐标设置为0。

source: Vector subtraction
zh: 矢量减法

source: Subtracts a vector from another. Use this to subtract a vector stored in a variable:
zh: 从一个向量中减去另一个向量。用它来减去存储在变量中的向量：

source: You can also subtract individually X, Y and Z coordinates, which has the same effect of adding the opposite coordinates.
zh: 你还可以单独减去 X、Y 和 Z 坐标，这与添加相反坐标具有相同的效果。

source: Complex vector mechanics
zh: 复杂矢量力学

source: Vector cross product
zh: 向量叉积

source: Computes the cross product of vectors `vec1` and `vec2` and saves it in a variable. The result is another vector.
zh: 计算向量`vec1`和`vec2`的叉积并将其保存在变量中。结果是另一个向量。

source: Vector hadamard product
zh: 矢量哈达玛积

source: This multiplies the X, Y and Z coordinates of the two vectors separately and saves the result in a variable. The result is another vector.
zh: 这将两个向量的 X、Y 和 Z 坐标分别相乘，并将结果保存在变量中。结果是另一个向量。

source: 🎨 Visual
zh: 🎨 视觉

source: Send a message to a player
zh: 向玩家发送消息

source: This supports PAPI placeholders and color codes.
zh: 这支持 PAPI占位符和颜色代码。

source: Play a sound at target location
zh: 在目标位置播放声音

source: For sound names, you can either use Bukkit/Paper sound names from the [Bukkit javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html) or use the Minecraft [vanilla sound names](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Sounds.json/Java_Edition_values). Pitch ranges from 0.5 (low) to 2 (high).
zh: 对于声音名称，你可以使用 [Bukkitjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html)中的Bukkit/Paper声音名称，或使用Minecraft[原版声音名称](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Sounds.json/Java_Edition_values)。音高范围从0.5（低）到2（高）。

source: This mechanics also supports custom sound.
zh: 该机制还支持自定义声音。

source: Spawn a particle
zh: 产生一个粒子

source: Particle list [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Particle.html).
zh: 粒子列表[此处为](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Particle.html)。

source: Particles can be summoned with initial velocity by setting amount to 0. You can also use this to summon colored particles (`REDSTONE` particles notably). Integers provided in the `color` config section are in RGB format, from 0 to 255.
zh: 通过将 amount 设置为0，可以以初速度召唤粒子。你还可以使用它来召唤彩色粒子（特别是`REDSTONE`粒子）。`color`配置部分中提供的整数采用 RGB 格式，从0到255。

source: Or particles requiring block data (`BLOCK_CRACK`, `BLOCK_DUST` and `BLOCK_MARKER notably)`. You can find the list of materials that you can use in the `block` option [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Material.html).
zh: 或者需要块数据的粒子（`BLOCK_CRACK`、`BLOCK_DUST`和`BLOCK_MARKER notably)`。你可以在`block`选项中找到可以使用的材质列表 [此处为](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Material.html)。

source: Send an action bar message
zh: 发送动作栏消息

source: This supports PAPI placeholders and color codes. For message priority and duration, please refer to the [Messages](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/player-messages#send-to-action-bar) wiki page.
zh: 这支持 PAPI占位符和颜色代码。有关消息优先级和持续时间，请参阅 [Messages](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/player-messages#send-to-action-bar)wiki 页面。

source: Entity Targeters
zh: 实体目标选择器

source: > Under Construction
zh: > 建设中

source: Caster
zh: 脚轮

source: Use this targeter to target the skill caster. This targeter has no parameter so you can use just `target=caster` instead of `target={type=caster}`.
zh: 使用此目标选择器来瞄准技能脚轮。此目标选择器没有参数，因此你可以仅使用`target=caster`而不是`target={type=caster}`。

source: Cone
zh: 锥体

source: Targets entities in a cone, given a cone `angle` and `radius` which are numeric parameters. You can use math formulas for these parameters. The angle is given in degrees. The `source` parameter is optional, you may provide the starting point of the cone using a location targeter. It is set by default to the caster's position.
zh: 以圆锥体中的实体为目标，给定圆锥体`angle`和`radius`（它们是数字参数）。你可以对这些参数使用数学公式。角度以度为单位给出。`source`参数是可选的，你可以使用位置目标选择器提供圆锥体的起点。它默认设置为施法者的位置。

source: The `direction` parameter is also optional, you need to provide the cone's direction using a location targeter. It is set to the caster's eye direction by default.
zh: `direction`参数也是可选的，你需要使用位置目标选择器提供圆锥体的方向。默认情况下，它设置为施法者眼睛的方向。

source: Nearby entities
zh: 附近的实体

source: Use this to target entities around a specific location given a radius and height. This basically takes all entities in a **cylinder** with height `height` and radius `radius` around a center location.
zh: 使用它来定位给定半径和高度的特定位置周围的实体。这基本上将所有实体置于一个高度为`height`且围绕中心位置半径为`radius`的 **圆柱体** 中。

source: Setting the `source` parameter to `true` will use the script source location as center location. If set to `false`, ML will first try to use the script target location as center location.
zh: 将`source`参数设置为`true`将使用脚本源位置作为中心位置。如果设置为`false`，ML 将首先尝试使用脚本目标位置作为中心位置。

source: By default, the `nearby_entities` targeter ignores the caster/entity skill target. If you toggle off `ignore_caster`, the skill caster/entity skill target will be taken into account by this targeter.
zh: 默认情况下，`nearby_entities`目标选择器会忽略施法者/实体技能目标。如果你关闭`ignore_caster`，则目标选择器将考虑技能施法者/实体技能目标。

source: Nearest Entity
zh: 最近的实体

source: Takes the entity closest to the script target location, with a maximum range of `radius`.
zh: 获取最接近脚本目标位置的实体，最大范围为`radius`。

source: Setting the `source` parameter to true will use the script source location as center location. If set to false, ML will first try to use the script target location as center location.
zh: 将`source`参数设置为true将使用脚本源位置作为中心位置。如果设置为false，ML 将首先尝试使用脚本目标位置作为中心位置。

source: Target entity
zh: 目标实体

source: One of the simplest targeters, used to target the script target.
zh: 最简单的一种目标选择器，用于定位脚本目标。

source: Looking at
zh: 看着

source: Targets the entity the caster is looking at. It is possible that no entity is found, in which case the mechanic using this targeter will not be executed. `size` is the size of the raytrace, setting it to `1` means that you will hit entities which bounding boxes are at most 1 block away from your line of sight. `length` is the maximum distance at which an entity can be targeted. `ignore_passable` can be used to ignore passable blocks like tall grass or flowers.
zh: 瞄准施法者正在查看的实体。有可能没有找到任何实体，在这种情况下，使用此目标选择器的机制将不会被执行。`size`是光线追踪的大小，将其设置为`1`意味着你将击中边界框距离视线最多为1块的实体。`length`是实体可以瞄准的最大距离。`ignore_passable`可用于忽略可通过的方块，例如高草或花朵。

source: Variable target
zh: 可变目标

source: If an entity happens to be stored as a variable in a script, you can access it using this targeter.
zh: 如果某个实体恰好作为变量存储在脚本中，你可以使用此目标选择器访问它。

source: 🧟 Targeters
zh: 🧟目标选择器

source: Some mechanics require parameters like entities or positions: for instance, if you'd like to spawn a particle at a given position, you need to specify that exact position, which is done using **targeters**. If you'd like to deal X damage to an entity you must be able to tell ML what entity to damage.
zh: 某些机制需要实体或位置等参数：例如，如果你想在给定位置生成粒子，则需要指定该确切位置，这是使用 **目标选择器** 完成的。如果你想对实体造成 X 伤害，你必须能够告诉 ML 要损坏哪个实体。

source: There are targeters for both **entities** and **positions/locations**. Targeters can return multiple entities or positions at the same time, in which case the same script/mechanic will be executed multiple times, once for every entity/position.
zh: **实体**和**职位/位置**都有目标选择器。目标选择器可以同时返回多个实体或位置，在这种情况下，相同的脚本/机制将被执行多次，每个实体/位置一次。

source: | Targeter Type | Description |
zh: |目标选择器型|描述 |

source: | [Entity](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/entity) | Entity targeters |
zh: | [实体](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/entity)|实体目标选择器|

source: | [Location](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/location) | Location/position targeters |
zh: | [位置](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/location)|地点/位置目标选择器|

source: Location Targeters
zh: 位置目标选择器

source: Location targeters are used to specify locations where you want to execute a mechanic or script. Location targeters may return multiple locations, in which case the mechanic/script will be executed multiple times, once for each location.
zh: 位置目标选择器用于指定要执行机制或脚本的位置。位置目标选择器可能会返回多个位置，在这种情况下，机制/脚本将被执行多次，每个位置一次。

source: Use this to target the script caster's location. The optional `position` parameter allows you to access a precise location on the player's body, from lowest to highest: `FEET`, `BODY` (half way up), `EYES` (at eyes height), `TOP`. It is set to `BODY` by default.
zh: 使用它来定位脚本施法者的位置。可选的`position`参数允许你访问玩家机身上的精确位置，从最低到最高：`FEET`、`BODY`（中间）、`EYES`（眼睛高度）、`TOP`。默认设置为`BODY`。

source: Circle
zh: 圆

source: Use it to run a script multiple times with a set distance away from a center location. `amount` is the number of points samples on the circle. The higher, the "smoother" the circle will appear if you spawn particles for instance. `radius` is the radius of the circle.
zh: 使用它可以在距中心位置一定距离的情况下多次运行脚本。`amount`是圆上的样本点数。例如，如果你生成粒子，则越高，圆圈就会显得越“平滑”。`radius`是圆的半径。

source: Setting the `source` parameter to `true` will use the script source location as center location. If set to `false`, MythicLib will first try to use the script target location as center location.
zh: 将`source`参数设置为`true`将使用脚本源位置作为中心位置。如果设置为`false`，MythicLib将首先尝试使用脚本目标位置作为中心位置。

source: Custom position
zh: 自定义位置

source: Using this targeter you can input the position X, Y and Z manually. Setting `relative` to `true` will **add** to the location you input the target script location, or caster location if `source` is set to `false`. For instance, the following example returns one block above the script source location.
zh: 使用此目标选择器，你可以手动输入位置 X、Y 和 Z。将`relative`设置为`true`将**添加**到你输入目标脚本位置的位置，或者如果`source`设置为`false`则施法者位置。例如，以下示例返回脚本源位置上方的一个块。

source: Source location
zh: 源位置

source: Use it to target the script source location. It is usually the location of the player who ran the script initially.
zh: 使用它来定位脚本源位置。它通常是最初运行脚本的玩家的位置。

source: Target entity location
zh: 目标实体位置

source: The location of the script target entity. The optional `position` parameter allows you to access a precise location on the player's body, from lowest to highest: `FEET`, `BODY` (half way up), `EYES` (at eyes height), `TOP`. It is set to `BODY` by default.
zh: 脚本目标实体的位置。可选的`position`参数允许你访问玩家机身上的精确位置，从最低到最高：`FEET`、`BODY`（中间）、`EYES`（眼睛高度）、`TOP`。默认设置为`BODY`。

source: Target location
zh: 目标位置

source: Targets the script target location.
zh: 定位脚本目标位置。

source: Location variable
zh: 位置变量

source: If a location/position happens to be stored as a variable in a script, you can access it using this targeter. `name` is the name of the variable you want to use as target location.
zh: 如果位置/位置恰好存储为脚本中的变量，你可以使用此目标选择器访问它。`name`是要用作目标位置的变量的名称。

zh: 欢迎来到这个**关于使用MythicLib制作自定义脚本的小教程**。在本教程中，我们将介绍一些基本的机制用法，以便你可以为自己创建一些看起来不错的技能。

source: 📚 Variables
zh: 📚 变量

source: When provided mechanics do not provide enough configurability you can always use variables to recode some more complex script. Variables can be used to store temporary data or even do complex numeric or vector computations for advanced particle effects for instance.
zh: 当提供的机制没有提供足够的可配置性时，你始终可以使用变量来重新编码一些更复杂的脚本。例如，变量可用于存储临时数据，甚至可以为高级粒子效果进行复杂的数值或矢量计算。

source: Internal & Custom Variables
zh: 内部和自定义变量

source: There are two types of variables. First, **internal variables** or **reserved variables** have names which are reserved by MythicLib. They are used all of the time by MythicLib, and you cannot create custom variables with reserved variables names. You can access these variables using `<caster>` or `<target_location>` for instance.
zh: 有两种类型的变量。首先，**内部变量**或**保留变量**具有由MythicLib保留的名称。它们始终由MythicLib使用，并且你无法使用保留的变量名称创建自定义变量。例如，你可以使用`<caster>`或`<target_location>`访问这些变量。

source: | Variable | Type | Usage |
zh: |变量|类型 |用途 |

source: | `source` | position | Location where the script was cast |
zh: |`source`|位置|剧本拍摄地点|

source: | `target_location` | position | The target location **if it exists** |
zh: |`target_location`|位置|目标位置**如果存在** |

source: | `caster` | player | Player who cast the script |
zh: |`caster`|玩家|玩家剧本是谁选的？

source: | `attack` | attackMetadata | The attack which triggered the skill **if it exists** |
zh: |`attack`|攻击元数据 |触发技能的攻击**如果存在** |

source: | `stat` | statMap | The stat map of the caster BY THE TIME he cast the script |
zh: | `stat` | statMap | 施法者施放此脚本时的属性映射。 |

source: | `target` | entity | The skill target **if it exists** |
zh: |`target`|实体|技能目标**如果存在** |

source: | `random` | random | An extra module to generate random numbers. See below |
zh: |`random`|随机|用于生成随机数的额外模块。见下文|

source: On the other hand, **custom variables** are initialized and can be manipulated by the user. You can access them using `<your_variable_name>`, use them in numeric formulas or just like PAPI placeholders in any mechanic or condition. MythicLib comes with many mechanics that let you initialize and edit your custom variables. The full list is available [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro).
zh: 另一方面，**自定义变量**被初始化并且可以由用户操作。你可以使用`<your_variable_name>`访问它们，在数值公式中使用它们，或者就像在任何机制或条件下使用 PAPI占位符一样。MythicLib附带许多机制，可让你初始化和编辑自定义变量。完整列表可在[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro)。

source: Scopes
zh: 范围

source: Custom variables have **scopes**. This feature is very important since it determines if the variable is specific to the player, if it should be accessible by any player and if it should be saved when a script eventually runs its last mechanic.
zh: 自定义变量具有**范围**。此功能非常重要，因为它确定变量是否特定于玩家、是否可以由任何玩家访问以及在脚本最终运行其最后一个机制时是否应该保存它。

source: Internal variables don't need scopes.
zh: 内部变量不需要作用域。

source: There are three variables scopes available:
zh: 共有三个可用变量范围：

source: `SERVER` (a server variable is the same for all players and all scripts)
zh: `SERVER`（服务器变量对于所有玩家和所有脚本都是相同的）

source: `PLAYER` (a player variable is the same for all scripts ran by a specific player)
zh: `PLAYER`（玩家变量对于特定玩家运行的所有脚本都是相同的）

source: `SKILL` (the default scope. A skill/script variable will be lost when the script runs its last mechanic).
zh: `SKILL`（默认范围。当脚本运行最后一个机制时，技能/script 变量将丢失）。

source: You only need to provide the scope of your variable when editing or initializing it. When fetching the value of a custom variable using `<var.custom_var_name>`, there might be multiple variables with the same name but different scopes (one per scope, at most). In this case, priority is `SKILL` > `PLAYER` > `SERVER` (lowest scopes first).
zh: 你只需在编辑或初始化变量时提供变量的范围。使用`<var.custom_var_name>`获取自定义变量的值时，可能有多个具有相同名称但作用域不同的变量（每个作用域最多一个）。在这种情况下，优先级为`SKILL`>`PLAYER`>`SERVER`（范围最低的优先）。

source: Variables are typed: `<source>` is a location (where the script is ran from) whereas `<target>` is an entity (the skill target, if it exists). Variables also have **subvariables**: for instance, you can access the location of an entity using `<entity_variable.location>` which has the effect of transforming an entity variable into a location variable.
zh: 输入变量：`<source>`是一个位置（运行脚本的位置），而`<target>`是一个实体（技能目标，如果存在）。变量也有**子变量**：例如，你可以使用`<entity_variable.location>`访问实体的位置，这具有将实体变量转换为位置变量的效果。

source: A subvariable is also a variable which means you can use multiple dots to access subvariables of subvariables etc. to get the data wanted: `<caster.location.world.name>`
zh: 子变量也是一个变量，这意味着你可以使用多个点来访问子变量的子变量等以获得所需的数据：`<caster.location.world.name>`

source: Here is the list of all the currently supported variable types, as well as their subvariables
zh: 这是当前支持的所有变量类型及其子变量的列表

zh: 变量类型

source: AttributeMap
zh: 属性图

source: This is useful if you want to access some player's vanila attribute values. Example use: `<caster.attribute.max_health>`.
zh: 如果你想访问某些玩家的普通基础属性值，这非常有用。使用示例：`<caster.attribute.max_health>`。

source: Vanilla attributes shall not be mistaken for player stats which are added by the MMO plugins. Some of these stats are based on vanilla attributes, but not all of them. For instance, weapon crit chance is a custom stat which isn't based on any vanilla attribute so you can't access it using this variable type. You'll need to use the `statMap` variable type: `<caster.stat.critical_strike_chance>`. However since attack damage is based on a vanilla attribute, `<caster.stat.attack_damage>` will NOT return the correct value, because it only takes into account stat modifiers registered in MythicLib and not external attribute modifiers!
zh: 原版基础属性不得误认为是 MMO 插件添加的玩家属性。其中一些属性基于原版基础属性，但不是全部。例如，武器暴击几率是自定义的属性，它不基于任何原版基础属性，因此你无法使用此变量类型访问它。你需要使用`statMap`变量类型：`<caster.stat.critical_strike_chance>`。然而，由于攻击伤害基于原版基础属性，`<caster.stat.attack_damage>`将不会返回正确的值，因为它只考虑在MythicLib中注册的属性修正器而不是外部基础属性修饰符！

zh: |`movement_speed`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `flying_speed` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`flying_speed`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `attack_damage` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`attack_damage`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `attack_knockback` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`attack_knockback`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `attack_speed` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`attack_speed`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `armor` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`armor`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `armor_toughness` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`armor_toughness`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: | `luck` | double | Player attribute value |
zh: |`luck`|双|玩家基础属性值 |

source: CooldownMap
zh: 冷却图

source: Cooldown maps are used to store a player's cooldown values. Cooldowns are used by MythicLib for damage mitigation (block, parrying, dodging) and for skill cooldowns, and by MMOItems for item cooldowns. You can access the cooldown map of the player casting the script using `<caster.cooldown>`.

source: Using subvariable `some_key` will return a double corresponding to the remaining cooldown for the given cooldown key. For instance, `<caster.cooldown.mmoitem_small_mana_pot>` returns the remaining cooldown for the MMOItem with ID `SMALL_MANA_POT`, `<caster.cooldown.hello>` returns the remaining cooldown for the skill/item/etc. with cooldown key `hello`.

zh: 属性映射用于存储来自特定玩家的所有属性修正器。你可以使用`<caster.stat>`访问脚本运行程序的属性映射。然后使用`<caster.stat.skill_critical_strike_chance>`检索属性值。

source: Vanilla attributes shall not be mistaken for player stats which are added by the MMO plugins. Some of these stats are based on vanilla attributes, but not all of them. For instance, weapon crit chance is a custom stat which isn't based on any vanilla attribute so you can't access it using this variable type. You'll need to use the `StatMap` variable type: `<caster.stat.critical_strike_chance>`. However since attack damage is based on a vanilla attribute, `<caster.stat.attack_damage>` will NOT return the correct value, because it only takes into account stat modifiers registered in MythicLib and not external attribute modifiers!
zh: 原版基础属性不得误认为是 MMO 插件添加的玩家属性。其中一些属性基于原版基础属性，但不是全部。例如，武器暴击几率是自定义的属性，它不基于任何原版基础属性，因此你无法使用此变量类型访问它。你需要使用`StatMap`变量类型：`<caster.stat.critical_strike_chance>`。然而，由于攻击伤害基于原版基础属性，`<caster.stat.attack_damage>`将不会返回正确的值，因为它只考虑在MythicLib中注册的属性修正器而不是外部基础属性修饰符！

source: Edit damage types of built-in skills
zh: 编辑built-in技能的伤害类型

source: Built-in skills that deal damage (e.g. *Fireball*, *Shockwave*, etc.) can have their damage types changed.
zh: 造成伤害的Built-in技能（e.g。*火球*、*冲击波*等）可以更改其伤害类型。

source: > This option only applies to built-in skills. In particular, it will not work for custom skills added through MythicMobs. To change the damage types of custom skills, see the [next section](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin#edit-damage-types-of-custom-skills).
zh: > 此选项仅适用于built-in技能。特别是，它不适用于通过MythicMobs添加的自定义技能。要更改自定义技能的损坏类型，请参阅[下一节](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin#edit-damage-types-of-custom-skills)。

source: For example, the following syntax changes the types of damage dealt by the *Firebolt* skill to *Magic*, *Skill* and *Projectile*. It is taken from the `MythicLib/skill/default_skills.yml` config file.
zh: 例如，以下语法将 *Firebolt*技能造成的伤害类型更改为 *Magic*、*技能* 和 *Projectile*。它取自`MythicLib/skill/default_skills.yml`配置文件。

source: To change the types of damage dealt by a built-in skill, use the `damage_types` parameter inside the skill configuration. If it is not present in the config file, add it. You can specify one or more damage types, separated by commas.
zh: 要更改built-in技能造成的伤害类型，请在技能配置中使用`damage_types`参数。如果配置文件中不存在，请添加它。你可以指定一种或多种损坏类型，以逗号分隔。

source: Edit damage types of custom skills
zh: 编辑自定义技能的损坏类型

source: To change the types of damage dealt by a built-in skill, use the `damage_types` parameter inside the skill configuration. If it is not present in the config file, add it. You can specify one or more damage types.
zh: 要更改built-in技能造成的伤害类型，请在技能配置中使用`damage_types`参数。如果配置文件中不存在，请添加它。你可以指定一种或多种损坏类型。

source: If you have a custom skill added through MythicMobs, you can change its damage types by specifying the `types` parameter when using the `mmodamage` skill mechanic. You can find more information on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#dealing-damage).
zh: 如果你通过MythicMobs添加了自定义技能，则可以在使用`mmodamage`技能机制时通过指定`types`参数来更改其伤害类型。你可以在[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#dealing-damage)]上找到更多信息。

source: If you have a custom skill added through MythicLib, you can change its damage types by specifying the `damage_types` parameter in the `damage` skill mechanic. You can find more information on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/offense#deal-damage-to-an-entity).
zh: 如果你通过MythicLib添加了自定义技能，则可以通过在`damage`技能机制中指定`damage_types`参数来更改其伤害类型。你可以在[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/offense#deal-damage-to-an-entity)]上找到更多信息。

source: Using CoreTools
zh: 使用CoreTools

source: [CoreTools](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/coretools.125126/) can be used to create skills that you can run in all MMO plugins.
zh: [CoreTools](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/coretools.125126/)可用于创建可在所有 MMO 插件中运行的技能。

source: Custom Skill Registration
zh: 定制技能注册

source: First, code your skill in CoreTools. For this tutorial, we will be using a very simple script; it is the built-in script which ID `script3`.
zh: 首先，将技能编码为CoreTools。在本教程中，我们将使用一个非常简单的脚本；它是built-in脚本，其中ID`script3`。

source: Then, open up any YML config file inside the `MythicLib/skill` folder and paste the following:

source: After reloading both plugins, you can now use the skill `MY_SKILL_3` in MMOItems and MMOCore. You can try to cast it using `/ml debug cast MY_SKILL_3`, and you should see the message appear in the player chat.
zh: 重新加载这两个插件后，你现在可以在MMOItems和MMOCore中使用技能`MY_SKILL_3`。你可以尝试使用`/ml debug cast MY_SKILL_3`来投射它，你应该会看到该消息出现在玩家聊天中。

source: Skill Modifiers
zh: 技能修饰符

source: There is currently no way to retrieve skill modifiers when using CoreTools skills, unlike when using MythicMobs.
zh: 目前，使用CoreTools技能时无法检索技能修饰符，这与使用MythicMobs时不同。

source: Skill conditions
zh: 技能条件

source: Just like MythicMobs, skills registered in MythicLib using CoreTools can have conditions. If any of the CoreTools conditions is not met, the skill will not be cast, no mana will be consumed, no cooldown will be applied, etc.
zh: 就像MythicMobs一样，使用CoreTools在MythicLib中注册的技能也可以有条件。如果不满足任何CoreTools条件，则不会施放技能，不会消耗魔力，不会应用冷却时间等。

source: Using Fabled
zh: 使用Fabled

source: Fabled, formerly known as ProSkillAPI, or SkillAPI, is a powerful skill creation and management plugin. You can create custom skills inside Fabled and use them inside MythicLib.
zh: Fabled，原名 ProSkillAPI ，或SkillAPI，是一个强大的技能创建和管理插件。你可以在Fabled内创建自定义技能并在MythicLib内使用它们。

source: > As of MythicLib 1.6.2 snapshots, SkillAPI and ProSkillAPI are no longer supported, as both plugins are no longer being actively maintained. We ask users to move to Fabled instead.
zh: > 从MythicLib1.6.2快照开始，不再支持SkillAPI和 ProSkillAPI，因为这两个插件都不再得到积极维护。我们要求用户改用Fabled。

source: Similarly to MythicMobs, you can register custom skills into MythicLib using the Fabled skill editor. The process is the exact same as in [this tutorial](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#custom-skill-registration) apart from the format of the MythicLib skill configuration file.
zh: 与MythicMobs类似，你可以使用Fabled技能编辑器将自定义技能注册到MythicLib中。除了MythicLib技能配置文件的格式之外，该过程与[本教程](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#custom-skill-registration)中的过程完全相同。
