zh: 首先，使用Fabled技能编辑器对技能进行编码。假设你编码的技能具有ID`Firebolt`。打开`MythicLib/skill`文件夹中的 YML 配置文件并粘贴以下内容：

source: There is currently no way to retrieve skill modifiers when using Fabled skills, unlike when using MythicMobs. The `parameters` section in the config snippet above can therefore be omitted.
zh: 目前，使用Fabled技能时无法检索技能修饰符，这与使用MythicMobs时不同。因此可以省略上面配置片段中的`parameters`部分。

source: That being said, all skills registered using Fabled have a `level` skill modifier which hooks directly into Fabled skill level system. You can setup skill mechanic numerical parameters to linearly scale on the skill level. Using MythicMobs you'd have been able to setup any type of scaling you want (not limited to linear scaling).
zh: 也就是说，所有使用Fabled注册的技能都有一个`level`技能修饰符，它直接挂钩到Fabled技能关卡系统。你可以将技能机械数值参数设置为在技能等级上线性缩放。使用MythicMobs，你可以设置你想要的任何类型的缩放（不限于线性缩放）。

source: Just like `cooldown` `mana` and `stamina`, the `level` modifier is automatically registered.
zh: 就像`cooldown` `mana`和`stamina`一样，`level`修饰符会自动注册。

source: > While Fabled remains an option for custom skill creation, we still recommend using MythicMobs instead
zh: > 虽然Fabled仍然是自定义技能创建的选项，但我们仍然建议使用MythicMobs

source: 💫 Creating Custom Skills
zh: 💫 创建自定义技能

source: Using MythicMobs
zh: 使用MythicMobs

source: This page will help you register custom skills in MythicLib/MMOItems/MMOCore using the Mythic/MythicMobs scripting language. Here are the main steps:
zh: 此页面将帮助你使用 Mythic/MythicMobs脚本语言在MythicLib/MMOItems/MMOCore中注册自定义技能。主要步骤如下：

source: Code a Mythic script
zh: 编写神话脚本

source: Register that script as a custom MythicLib skill,
zh: 将该脚本注册为自定义MythicLib技能，

source: Reload the plugins.
zh: 重新加载插件。

source: 1/ Code a MythicMobs skill
zh: 1/ 代码MythicMobs技能

source: The first step is to code what your skill does using the MythicMobs scripting language. In this tutorial, we'll consider a skill example that we found in the MythicMobs manual. It is a simple fire projectile that deals 10 damage and slows the first enemy it hits for 2 sec.
zh: 第一步是使用MythicMobs脚本语言对技能执行的操作进行编码。在本教程中，我们将考虑在MythicMobs手册中找到的技能示例。它是一种简单的火焰射弹，可造成10伤害并使其击中的第一个敌人减速2秒。

source: 2/ Declare it as a MythicLib skill
zh: 2/ 将其声明为MythicLib技能

source: Go to the `MythicLib/skill` folder and create a YAML configuration file, whose name can be whatever you want - let's say you name it `tutorial.yml`. Just like in MythicMobs, you can:
zh: 转到`MythicLib/skill`文件夹并创建一个YAML配置文件，其名称可以是你想要的任何名称 - 假设你将其命名为`tutorial.yml`。就像在MythicMobs中一样，你可以：

source: have multiple skills within the same config file
zh: 同一配置文件中有多个技能

source: organize your files into subfolders
zh: 将文件组织到子文件夹中

source: file and folder names can be whatever you want
zh: 文件和文件夹名称可以是你想要的任何名称

source: You will find below a template MythicLib skill definition that you can copy and paste into your config file. We will go through each of the config options in the following sections.
zh: 你将在下面找到模板MythicLib技能定义，你可以将其复制并粘贴到配置文件中。我们将在以下部分中详细介绍每个配置选项。

source: Config Options
zh: 配置选项

source: Skill Identifier
zh: 技能标识符

source: Let's go through the `FIRE_BOLT` configuration section. First, nicely format the config section name so that it matches that `UPPERCASE_ID_FORMAT` because it's the one used for skills in MMOItems/MMOCore.
zh: 让我们看一下`FIRE_BOLT`配置部分。首先，很好地格式化配置节名称，使其与`UPPERCASE_ID_FORMAT`匹配，因为它是MMOItems/MMOCore中用于技能的名称。

source: Skill Source
zh: 技能源码

source: In order to add custom model data, item model... use the following syntax. Note that all of these parameters are optional.

source: The `lore` option lets you customize the skill description that players will see in the MMOCore skill UI. Note the use of placeholders such as `{cooldown}`, `{mana}`, `{mana_name}` that will be dynamically replaced when the skill is displayed.
zh: `lore`选项允许你自定义技能描述，玩家将在MMOCore技能UI 中看到。请注意占位符的使用，例如`{cooldown}`、`{mana}`、`{mana_name}`，当显示技能时，它们将被动态替换。

source: The `name` option lets you customize the skill name. Note that this is the only field used by MMOItems, as the icon and lore are only being used by MMOCore.
zh: `name`选项允许你自定义技能名称。请注意，这是MMOItems使用的唯一字段，因为图标和描述仅由MMOCore使用。

source: Trigger
zh: 触发

source: The `trigger` option defines the default trigger type/casting method for that skill. The list of available trigger types is available on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers).
zh: `trigger`选项定义该技能的默认触发类型/转换方法。可用触发器类型的列表可在 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)上找到。

source: Skills that have a trigger are called *passive skills* as they trigger automatically. Use the following syntax to create a passive skill that triggers when the player shift right clicks:

source: Skills with no trigger are called *active skills* and need to be manually [cast by players](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting). Do not provide a trigger if you want to make an active skill.
zh: 没有触发器的技能被称为*主动技能*，需要手动[由玩家](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)施放。如果你想要激活技能，请不要提供触发器。

source: > Note that if you specify a trigger in the MMOCore class skill config, it can either modify the trigger of a skill, or turn an active skill into a passive skill.
zh: > 请注意，如果你在MMOCore职业技能配置中指定触发器，它可以修改技能的触发器，或将主动技能变为被动技能。

source: Skill Categories
zh: 技能类别

source: Each skill can be assigned to a list of categories through the field `categories`. By default, each skill is associated with two categories: its skill ID (`FIREBALL` for instance, not to be mistaken with the skill name), and either `ACTIVE` or `PASSIVE` depending on if it is an active or passive skill. These categories can be used inside [skill slot formulas](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots).
zh: 每个技能都可以通过字段`categories`分配到类别列表。默认情况下，每个技能与两个类别相关联：其技能、ID（例如`FIREBALL`，不要与技能名称混淆），以及`ACTIVE`或`PASSIVE`，具体取决于它是主动还是被动技能。这些类别可以在 [技能插槽公式](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots)中使用。

source: The `parameters` section lets you define the skill modifiers that your skill will use. In our example, we defined two skill modifiers: `damage` and `duration`. Each modifier has a `name` (displayed in the skill UI), a `player` section (which defines how the modifier scales with player level) and an `item` section (which defines how the modifier scales with item level).
zh: `parameters`部分允许你定义技能将使用的技能修饰符。在我们的示例中，我们定义了两个技能修饰符：`damage`和`duration`。每个修改器都有一个`name`（显示在技能UI 中）、一个`player`部分（定义修改器如何随玩家等级缩放）和`item`部分（定义修改器如何随物品等级缩放）。

source: The `player` section dictates the scaling of the skill modifier when the skill is cast through MMOCore classes. The `item` section dictates the default skill parameter value when the skill is placed onto an MMOItems item. The `name` field is used by both MMOCore UIs and MMOItems for the item lore.
zh: `player`部分规定当技能通过MMOCore职业投射时技能修改器的缩放比例。`item`部分规定了将技能放置到MMOItems物品上时的默认技能参数值。`name`字段由MMOCoreUI 和MMOItems用于物品描述。

source: Note that you have two possibilities to provide the `player` section. You can either provide a `base` and `per-level` value, which will result in a linear scaling:
zh: 请注意，你可以通过两种方式提供`player`部分。你可以提供`base`和`per-level`值，这将导致线性缩放：

source: You can also provide a fully custom formula using the `{level}` placeholder, which represents the player skill level:
zh: 你还可以使用`{level}`占位符提供完全自定义的公式，它代表玩家技能等级：

source: The `item` field, however, is always a flat decimal number.
zh: 然而，`item`字段始终是平面十进制数。

source: `extra-skills`
zh: `extra-skills`

source: As you can see, you can put Mythic scripts inside of the MythicLib config file. That is what the `extra-skills` config section is all about - any Mythic script that you place inside this configuration section will be passed to Mythic. In order to register MythicLib custom skills, you can either put your Mythic scripts inside of the ML config file, or simply pass a reference (the script name i.e `FireBolt`) to an existing Mythic script. Either way, the Mythic script names must match:
zh: 如你所见，你可以将 Mythic 脚本放入MythicLib配置文件中。这就是`extra-skills`配置部分的全部内容 - 你放置在此配置部分中的任何 Mythic 脚本都将传递给 Mythic。为了注册MythicLib自定义技能，你可以将 Mythic 脚本放入 ML 配置文件中，或者简单地将引用（脚本名称i.e`FireBolt`）传递给现有的 Mythic 脚本。无论哪种方式，Mythic 脚本名称都必须匹配：

source: 3/ Reload the plugins
zh: 3/ 重新加载插件

source: Reload MythicMobs using `/mm reload`. By now, you should be able to use `/mm debug cast FireBolt` to test your MythicMobs skill.
zh: 使用`/mm reload`重新加载MythicMobs。现在，你应该能够使用`/mm debug cast FireBolt`来测试你的MythicMobs技能。

source: Reload MythicLib using `/ml reload`. By now, your skill should be registered in MythicLib, and you should be able to use `/ml debug cast FIRE_BOLT` to test your MMO skill.
zh: 使用`/ml reload`重新加载MythicLib。现在，你的技能应该已在MythicLib中注册，并且你应该能够使用`/ml debug cast FIRE_BOLT`来测试你的 MMO技能。

source: That's it! You do not need additional config files for MMOItems or MMOCore, as both of these plugins directly use the MythicLib skill registry.
zh: 就是这样！你不需要MMOItems或MMOCore的额外配置文件，因为这两个插件都直接使用MythicLib技能注册表。

source: Skill Conditions
zh: 技能条件

source: Custom MM skills also support skill conditions. If any of the skill conditions is not met, the skill won't cast and no mana will be consumed.
zh: 定制MM技能也支持技能条件。如果不满足任何技能条件，则技能将不会施放，并且不会消耗魔力。

zh: 检索MythicMobs技能内的 MMO技能修改器

source: > Some of the features described below are not available in the free version of MythicMobs.
zh: > 下面描述的一些功能在MythicMobs免费版本中不可用。

zh: 我们再考虑一下`Fire-Bolt`技能。

zh: 如前所述，以下技能目前造成的伤害与10持平。我们希望该值与MMOCore技能等级或MMOItems物品功率成比例。

source: The following skill deals damage equivalent to the `damage` MythicLib skill modifier. The `<modifier.xxx>` allows to forward MythicLib skill parameter values to MythicMobs math formulas used inside mechanics, conditions...
zh: 以下技能造成的伤害相当于`damage`MythicLib技能修正值。`<modifier.xxx>`允许将MythicLib技能参数值转发到机械、条件内部使用的MythicMobs数学公式...

source: These placeholders can be combined with math formulas. In the following example, the `duration` modifier is multiplied by 20 to convert seconds into ticks.
zh: 这些占位符可以与数学公式组合。在以下示例中，`duration`修饰符乘以20以将秒转换为刻。

zh: 以下是MythicLib实现的占位符的完整列表，可在MythicMobs技能中找到。

source: | `<modifier.(mod_name)>` | Skill modifier, as decimal number |
zh: |`<modifier.(mod_name)>`|技能修饰符，十进制数 |

source: | `<modifier.int.(mod_name)>` | Skill modifier, as integer |
zh: |`<modifier.int.(mod_name)>`|技能修饰符，作为整数 |

source: | `<cooldown.skill_(name)>` | Remaining cooldown for a skill |
zh: |`<cooldown.skill_(name)>`|剩余冷却时间为技能|

source: | `<mmostat.(stat_name)>` | Player stat value, as decimal number. Ex: `<mmostat.attack_damage>` |
zh: |`<mmostat.(stat_name)>`|玩家属性值，十进制数。例如：`<mmostat.attack_damage>`|

source: | `<mana>` | The player's current mana (MMOCore) |
zh: |`<mana>`|玩家的当前魔力(MMOCore) |

source: | `<stamina>` | The player's current stamina (MMOCore) |
zh: |`<stamina>`|玩家的当前耐力(MMOCore) |

source: | `<stellium>` | The player's current stellium (MMOCore) |
zh: |`<stellium>`|玩家当前的群星(MMOCore) |

source: Dealing Damage
zh: 造成伤害

source: > This is subject to change for better support of the MythicLib damage system in the future.
zh: > 为了将来更好地支持MythicLib伤害系统，此内容可能会发生变化。

source: Use the `mmodamage` mechanic instead of the native `damage` mechanic to deal damage with MMO damage types.
zh: 使用`mmodamage`机制而不是原生`damage`机制来处理 MMO 伤害类型的伤害。

source: You can specify the ability damage using `amount` or `a` as well as the damage types using `types` or `t`. The list of available damage types can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage).
zh: 你可以使用`amount`或`a`指定能力伤害，以及使用`types`或`t`指定伤害类型。可用损坏类型的列表可以在[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/damage)找到。

source: It works just like the default `damage` MythicMobs skill mechanic, except that it completely supports the MythicLib damage system, which means that it will apply damage buff stats (additional skill damage, etc), damage reduction stats, on-hit effects (on-hit abilities from MMOItems when using the WEAPON damage type), skills from MMOCore that trigger when dealing damage to entities....
zh: 它的工作原理就像默认的`damage`MythicMobs技能机制，不同之处在于它完全支持MythicLib伤害系统，这意味着它将应用伤害增益属性（额外的技能伤害等），伤害减免属性，on-hit效果（使用武器伤害类型时来自MMOItems的on-hit能力），来自MMOCore的技能对实体造成伤害时触发......

source: For instance, the following mob deals 10 *Physical*-*Weapon* damage every 2 seconds to all nearby entities.
zh: 例如，以下生物每2秒对所有附近的实体造成10*物理*-*武器* 伤害。

source: Critical strikes
zh: 暴击

source: By default, weapon and skill critical strikes apply to damage types `WEAPON` and `SKILL` respectively. If the damage instance dealt has at least type *Weapon*, it will be able to deal *Weapon* damage. If it has at least type *Skill*, it will be able to deal *Skill* damage.
zh: 默认情况下，武器和技能暴击分别适用于损坏类型`WEAPON`和`SKILL`。如果造成的伤害实例至少具有 *武器* 类型，它将能够造成 *武器* 伤害。如果它至少具有 *技能* 类型，它将能够造成 *技能* 伤害。

source: If a damage instance deals damage with neither *Weapon* nor *Skill* type, it won't be able to deal critical strikes. This can be useful for DoT (*damage over time*), bleeding, or poison damage.
zh: 如果伤害实例造成的伤害既不是 *武器* 也不是 *技能* 类型，则它将无法造成暴击。这对于 DoT（*随时间变化的伤害*）、流血或中毒伤害很有用。

source: Note that this is the default behavior of critical strikes, and that it can be fully modified through the use of custom [on-hit effects](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/on-hit-effects).
zh: 请注意，这是暴击的默认行为，并且可以通过使用自定义 [on-hit效果](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/on-hit-effects)来完全修改它。

source: Increase/Decrease Damage Dealt
zh: 增加/减少造成的伤害

Currently this factor is `1 + <modifier.extra> / 100` so if the `extra` skill modifier is set to 50, *Skill* damage will be increased by 50%. You can use this mechanic to increase incoming damage dealt by entities or players by a certain factor (e.g increase damage when low on health).

source: If you want to increase damage from any source (with no damage type), use:

source: Checking if the skill caster can target another entity
zh: 检查技能施法者是否可以瞄准另一个实体

source: Using the `mmoCanTarget{..}` MythicMobs condition, you can check if any player can target another entity. Here is the format:
zh: 使用`mmoCanTarget{..}`MythicMobs条件，你可以检查是否有任何玩家可以定位另一个实体。格式如下：

source: There are two different interaction types: `OFFENSE_ACTION`, `SUPPORT_ACTION`. For instance, a player will be able to target another player when using a buffing skill (like a heal or a speed boost) but the same target won't be valid if that skill becomes offensive (deals damage or inflicts debuffs). It is therefore very important to specify what type of interaction you are talking about. The PvP/PvE Interaction Rules user guide is available [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/combat).
zh: 有两种不同的交互类型：`OFFENSE_ACTION`、`SUPPORT_ACTION`。例如，当使用增益技能（如治疗或速度提升）时，玩家将能够瞄准另一个玩家，但如果技能变得具有攻击性（造成伤害或造成减益），则同一目标将无效。因此，指定你所讨论的交互类型非常重要。PvP/PvE交互规则用户指南可在 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/combat)。

source: Using MythicLib
zh: 使用MythicLib

source: MythicLib [scripts](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/intro) can easily be turned into custom skills that can be used in MMOItems or MMOCore. We first need to write a MythicLib script, then declare it as a skill. A script basically says "what happens", while a skill provides more metadata including its mana cost, cooldown, damage, GUI lore, icon....
zh: MythicLib[脚本](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/intro)可以轻松转换为可在MMOItems或MMOCore中使用的自定义技能。我们首先需要编写一个MythicLib脚本，然后将其声明为技能。脚本基本上说“发生了什么”，而技能提供更多元数据，包括其魔力成本、冷却时间、损坏、GUI描述、图标......

zh: 1/ 编写MythicLib脚本

source: ⌚ Delays and Timers
zh: ⌚ 延迟和计时器

source: Skills that run every X ticks (timers)
zh: 技能每 X 个周期运行一次（计时器）

source: `TIMER` is a special trigger type that casts a skill every X ticks. To setup timed skills, simply define the timer period in ticks using the `timer` skill modifier. This is a default skill modifier for **ANY** skill, just like `cooldown` or `mana`. If the skill trigger is not set to `TIMER`, this skill modifier becomes 100% useless and you can just ignore it.
zh: `TIMER`是一种特殊的触发器类型，每 X 个周期就会投射技能。要设置定时技能，只需使用`timer`技能修饰符定义计时器周期（以刻为单位）。这是 **ANY**技能的默认技能修饰符，就像`cooldown`或`mana`一样。如果技能触发器未设置为`TIMER`，则此技能修饰符将变为100%无用，你可以忽略它。

source: Adding delays to skills
zh: 向技能添加延迟

source: Since MythicLib 1.5, any skill can have a **casting delay**. When casting such skill, the player is temporarily slowed down and must wait a small period of time before the skill is actually cast. This makes for a great RPG feature for skills like teleports or other super powerful skills.
zh: 自MythicLib1.5起，任何技能都可能有**投射延迟**。当施放此类技能时，玩家会暂时减慢，并且必须等待一小段时间才能实际施放技能。这为技能提供了出色的RPG功能，例如传送或其他超级强大的技能。

source: You can configure specific options for the casting delay in the MythicLib config file:
zh: 你可以在MythicLib配置文件中配置投射延迟的特定选项：

source: The `slowness` option dictates how much the player is slowed down during the skill delay. When enabling `cancel-on-move`, the skill will cancel if the player moves: in that case, adding slowness is pretty useless.
zh: `slowness`选项指示玩家在技能延迟期间减慢的程度。当启用`cancel-on-move`时，如果玩家移动，技能将取消：在这种情况下，增加速度是毫无用处的。

source: `cast-script` is the MythicLib script ran when the player enters the casting delay. By default, it simply plays a little sound. `cancel-script` is the script ran **if** the player cancels the skill while waiting. It will therefore only be triggered if `cancel-on-move` is enabled.
zh: `cast-script`是玩家进入投射延迟时运行的MythicLib脚本。默认情况下，它只是播放一点声音。`cancel-script`是当玩家在等待时取消技能时运行的脚本。因此，仅当`cancel-on-move`启用时才会触发。

source: You can also choose to enable or disable a custom bossbar which will display `CASTING` to the user.
zh: 你还可以选择启用或禁用自定义 bossbar，它将向用户显示`CASTING`。

source: ☄️ Introduction
zh: ☄️简介

source: Skills are everywhere in MMOCore or MMOItems. They can be bound to items or player classes or even be temporarily granted to players when wearing a full set of armor. Skills can do anything from damaging your enemies to buffing your team mates; they can be active (a firebolt that casts on right clicks) or passive (extra damage when the player is on fire).
zh: 技能在MMOCore或MMOItems中随处可见。它们可以绑定到物品或玩家职业，甚至在佩戴全套护甲时临时授予玩家。技能可以做任何事情，从伤害敌人到增强队友；它们可以是主动的（右键单击时会施放火弩箭）或被动的（当玩家着火时会造成额外伤害）。

source: > Since MythicLib 1.3, skills from both MMOItems and MMOCore are centralized into MythicLib. Therefore you can use MMOItems abilities in MMOCore player classes, and bind MMOCore skills to MMOItems items/item sets.
zh: > 由于MythicLib、1.3、MMOItems和MMOCore中的技能都集中到MythicLib中。因此，你可以在MMOCore玩家职业中使用MMOItems能力，并将MMOCore技能绑定到MMOItems物品/物品套装。

source: Skills have numerical **parameters** (damage, cooldown, duration...) that you can customize to adapt your skill power to your item or player level. For instance, you may edit how much damage an offensive skill does, how long some potion effect lasts, how much mana the skill consumes...
zh: 技能具有数字**参数**（伤害、冷却时间、持续时间...），你可以自定义这些参数，以使你的技能功率适应你的物品或玩家等级。例如，你可以编辑进攻性技能造成的伤害、某些药水效果持续多长时间、技能消耗多少魔力...

source: 💥 Triggers
zh: 💥 触发器

source: When using MMOItems or MMOCore, you will need to specify when a specific skill should be executed: when damaging an entity, when being damaged, when crouching etc. This is done using triggers. MMOItems used to call them *casting modes*.
zh: 使用 MMOItems 或 MMOCore 时，需要指定技能何时执行，例如对实体造成伤害、受到伤害或潜行时。这通过触发器设置；MMOItems 过去将它们称为*施法模式*。

source: These are the trigger types that you can use in MMO plugins to define when some skill is supposed to run.
zh: 你可以在 MMO 插件中使用这些触发器类型来定义某些技能何时应该运行。

source: When a skill/script is triggered
zh: 当技能/脚本被触发时

source: Some trigger types pass on special properties to the script/skill they trigger. For instance; when using the `ATTACK` trigger type:
zh: 某些触发器类型将特殊属性传递给它们触发的脚本/技能。例如;使用`ATTACK`触发类型时：

source: The `<target>` internal variable can be used to access the entity being damaged,
zh: `<target>`内部变量可用于访问被损坏的实体，

source: The `<attack>` internal variable returns metadata about the current attack,
zh: `<attack>`内部变量返回有关当前攻击的元数据，

source: `<attack.damage>` returns the attack damage.
zh: `<attack.damage>`返回攻击伤害。

source: Trigger types featuring entities/projectiles like `ATTACK`, `DAMAGED`, `DAMAGED_BY_ENTITY`, `KILL_ENTITY`, `SHOOT_TRIDENT`, `ARROW_TICK` etc. allow the user to use the `<target>` internal variable to access the shot projectile. These triggers also unlock the use of [entity and location targeters](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/intro) such as `target` and `target_location`.
zh: 具有`ATTACK`、`DAMAGED`、`DAMAGED_BY_ENTITY`、`KILL_ENTITY`、`SHOOT_TRIDENT`、`ARROW_TICK`等实体/投射物的触发器类型允许用户使用`<target>`内部变量来访问射击投射物。这些触发器还解锁了[实体和位置目标选择器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/targeters/intro)的使用，例如`target`和`target_location`。

source: Trigger types featuring world locations like `TRIDENT_LAND` or `ARROW_HIT` unlock the `target_location` location targeter as well as the `<target_location>` internal variable.
zh: 具有`TRIDENT_LAND`或`ARROW_HIT`等世界位置的触发器类型可解锁`target_location`位置目标选择器以及`<target_location>`内部变量。

source: Some triggers like `TIMER` or `RIGHT_CLICK` do not unlock any additional internal variable.
zh: 某些触发器（例如`TIMER`或`RIGHT_CLICK`）不会解锁任何其他内部变量。

source: `ATTACK` is the only trigger type which unlocks the `<attack>` internal variable as well as special mechanics (`multiply_damage`) or conditions (`has_damage_type`).
zh: `ATTACK`是唯一解锁`<attack>`内部变量以及特殊机制 (`multiply_damage`) 或条件 (`has_damage_type`) 的触发器类型。

source: Custom Triggers
zh: 自定义触发器

source: MythicLib allows users to define their own triggers and manually call them. This is a complex - yet super powerful - functionality that adds another layer of configurability on top of existing skills.
zh: MythicLib允许用户定义自己的触发器并手动调用它们。这是一个复杂但超级强大的功能，在现有技能的基础上添加了另一层可配置性。

source: Defining custom triggers
zh: 定义自定义触发器

source: You can define custom triggers inside the `MythicLib/triggers.yml` configuration file. Note that this file only contains user-defined triggers, as the triggers presented above are hard-coded and cannot be edited.
zh: 你可以在`MythicLib/triggers.yml`配置文件中定义自定义触发器。请注意，该文件仅包含user-defined触发器，因为上面提供的触发器是hard-coded并且无法编辑。

source: Calling custom triggers
zh: 调用自定义触发器

source: You can call custom triggers from inside a MMOLib script using the `call_trigger` mechanic. "Calling a trigger" refers to casting all the skills of a given player with matching trigger. For instance, on all player/mob attacks, MMOLib calls the `ATTACK` trigger under the hood.
zh: 在 MMOLib 脚本中，可使用 `call_trigger` 机制调用自定义触发器。“调用触发器”是指施放指定玩家所有匹配该触发器的技能。例如，每次玩家或生物攻击时，MMOLib 都会在内部调用 `ATTACK` 触发器。

source: Let's take the built-in weapon crits as an example. We would like to create a skill trigger, that gets called whenever a player performs a weapon critical strike while attacking.
zh: 我们以built-in武器暴击为例。我们想要创建一个技能触发器，每当玩家在攻击时执行武器暴击时就会调用该触发器。

source: The following code snippet is taken from the default `MythicLib/script/on_hit_effects.yml` file, which defines the behavior of weapon crits.
zh: 以下代码片段取自默认的`MythicLib/script/on_hit_effects.yml`文件，该文件定义了武器暴击的行为。

source: As you can see, when the `weapon_crit_script` script is called (i.e when a weapon crit occurs), the script eventually uses the `call_trigger` mechanic to call the `CRIT` user-defined skill trigger, that we defined earlier. This has the effect of casting all the caster's skills with trigger set to `CRIT`.
zh: 正如你所看到的，当调用`weapon_crit_script`脚本时（i.e发生武器暴击时），脚本最终使用`call_trigger`机制来调用我们之前定义的`CRIT`user-defined技能触发器。这具有在触发器设置为`CRIT`的情况下施放所有施法者的技能的效果。

source: > You can use the `call_trigger` mechanic to call ANY trigger, not only user-defined triggers. This can be used to create more complex behaviors like on-hit skill triggers, though it is the user's responsibility to make sure the proper skill metadata arguments are provided when calling built-in skill triggers.
zh: > 你可以使用`call_trigger`机制来调用任何触发器，而不仅仅是user-defined触发器。这可用于创建更复杂的行为，例如on-hit技能触发器，尽管用户有责任确保在调用built-in技能触发器时提供正确的技能元数据参数。

source: Disabling user-defined triggers
zh: 禁用user-defined触发器

source: This feature is quite hard to comprehend - if you wish to disable this feature altogether, simply comment out/delete the content of the `triggers.yml` file. Do not delete the config file itself, otherwise it will regenerate with its default content.
zh: 此功能很难理解 - 如果你希望完全禁用此功能，只需注释掉/删除`triggers.yml`文件的内容即可。不要删除配置文件本身，否则它将重新生成其默认内容。

source: 🤔 What is MythicLib?
zh: 🤔MythicLib是什么？

source: You might be wondering - **I installed MMOItems or MMOCore, I already have enough plugins on my server, why do I need to install and worry about an additional plugin?**
zh: 你可能想知道 - **我安装了MMOItems或MMOCore，我的服务器上已经有足够的插件，为什么我需要安装并担心额外的插件？**

source: MythicLib is a little more than just a library that contains shared code and utilities. It's a plugin that centralizes features to reduce config duplication and code redundancy.
zh: MythicLib不仅仅是一个包含共享代码和实用程序的库。它是一个集中功能以减少配置重复和代码冗余的插件。

source: It centralizes fundamental RPG features such as:
zh: 它集中了RPG的基本功能，例如：

source: the MMO player stats system,
zh: MMO玩家属性系统，

source: the MMO damage and element system,
zh: MMO伤害和元素系统，

source: damage and regen indicators,
zh: 伤害和再生指标，

source: the MMO skill system and scripting engine,
zh: MMO技能系统和脚本引擎，

source: integrations with other plugins,
zh: 与其他插件的集成，

source: many smaller-size shared config options,
zh: 许多smaller-size共享配置选项，

source: Using the `remove` subcommand, you can remove a specific stat modifier from a player using its `key`.
zh: 使用`remove`子命令，你可以使用`key`从玩家中删除特定的属性修正器。

source: > The following command unregisters the stat modifier given in the previous example.
zh: > 以下命令取消注册上一示例中给出的属性修正器。

source: Min/Max Stat Values
zh: 最小/最大属性值

source: Minimum and maximum values for the stat values. This means using '0 = 100' for CRITICAL_STRIKE_CHANCE means that you cannot have less than 0% and cannot have more than 100% critical strike chance. This is an important tool for server balance. You can balance stats like block rating, defense, max health, damage reduction etc.
zh: 属性值的最小值和最大值。这意味着对CRITICAL_STRIKE_CHANCE使用“0=100”意味着你的值不能小于0%且不能大于100%暴击几率。这是服务器平衡的重要工具。你可以平衡属性，如格挡等级、防御、最大生命值、伤害减少等。

source: General format is `{min_value} = {max_value}`
zh: 一般格式为`{min_value} = {max_value}`

source: Using only `= {max_value}` will disable the lower bound.
zh: 仅使用`= {max_value}`将禁用下限。

source: Using only `{min_value} =` will disable the upper bound.
zh: 仅使用`{min_value} =`将禁用上限。

source: If nothing is specified, there are no upper nor lower bounds.
zh: 如果未指定任何内容，则没有上限或下限。

source: > There is a slight difference between base stat value and minimal value. Min/max values are used to clamp the total stat value. The total stat value is the sum of the base stat value and all modifiers. In other words, the base stat value is like a permanent stat buff.
zh: > 基本属性值和最小值之间存在细微差别。最小/最大值用于限制属性总值。属性总值是基本属性值和所有修饰符的总和。换句话说，基本属性值就像永久的属性buff。
